strings.FUK_events.1.d:
Due to Oleksandr Ohloblyn's unpopular policies and obvious signs of collaboration with the nazis, in particular, aiding and abetting in racial cleansing-the mass extermination of the Jewish population during World War II in Babyn Yar-and his clear dictatorial tendencies, Danylo Skoropadskyi, a descendant of the last hetman of Ukraine, Pavlo Skoropadsky, with the support of the free Cossack troops and the direct assistance of Stus's United Struggle faction, arrested the elected president on suspicion of treason...

Exactly 46 years ago, on the night of April 29-30, 1918, Pavlo Skoropadskyi also staged a coup against an ineffective government to save Ukraine. It is a strange coincidence, but it seems that fate decided to give Ukraine a reliable pillar of support for society - a hetman.

Now only Danylo will decide the next years of an entire nation that has placed its trust in the hetman. Step by step, plan by plan, brick by brick, Ukraine will rise like a phoenix from the ashes of ruin. The UHS will surpass all other political forces in building a new, strong, globally important Ukrainian Hetmanate!
strings.FUK_events.1.a: Glory to Hetmanate! Long Live Skoropadskyi!
strings.FUK_events.2.d:
Dziuba couldn't believe it. The situation had quickly spiraled out of his control. It was all over. He should have foreseen the consequences of starting repressions against the fascists. It was one thing when all failures could be blamed on the controversial Ohloblyn, but it was quite another when it came to a respected general in the army, a hero of the civil war, and Stus's right-hand man.

Taras Bulba-Borovets refused to submit to our repressive policy against despotism in the country, and together with Stus and Danylo Skoropadskyi, they formed a coalition, supported by 80% of our army, and are already demanding in front of the government building on Khreshchatyk in Kyiv that Ivan Dziuba renounce all presidential powers granted to him by the people.

If he agrees to the military's demands, he will face life-long house arrest somewhere in Bila Tserkva, but if he refuses, citing his right to continue performing presidential functions, he will be arrested and imprisoned.So he chose the path of freedom and voluntarily renounced the position of President of the Ukrainian People Republic.

However, when Stus arrived at the parliament to take the oath, Danylo Skoropadskyi appeared with loyal, well-armed units of the “Free Cossacks”. He announced to the entire parliament that from now on he would become the Hetman-leader of the new Ukrainian Hetmanate, and anyone who did not agree with this would be immediately thrown out into the street and stripped of all ranks, like useless trash. The first to recognize the new Hetman was General Taras Bulba-Borovets, because he saw in him the energy and salvation that the Ukrainian land had been waiting for so long. Vasyl Stus agreed only on the condition that he be given the status of Prime Minister in the Hetmanate.
strings.FUK_events.2.a: Ukraine was saved from socialism in time
strings.FUK_events.4.d:
It was a special and long-awaited day for Petro, because finally, after the reconstruction of the once prestigious elite school in Kyiv, which had been closed for several years, he could continue his education without hindrance.Thanks to the efforts of the local city administration, with state investment, a massive restoration of schools across the country has begun.

Galina, the boy's mother, packed the necessary school supplies into his backpack and gave him a generous allowance for the week to donate to further repairs and purchases of books, Ukrainian literature, and educational textbooks for the school. In these post-war times, decades of occupation have resulted in significant illiteracy among the local population. Although teachers were selected based on passing an exam demonstrating sufficient knowledge of their subject, especially fluency in the Ukrainian language, there were cases of teachers lacking experience compared to teachers in other European countries.Wishing him all the best, Galina asked her son to study so that his father would always be proud of him.

Due to traffic problems, the boy was late to the bus station and ended up being the last to arrive in class. All the other first-graders were already sitting at their desks, and the homeroom teacher was trying to keep the class quiet and orderly until the last pupil arrived. Carefully opening the door to the sunlit classroom and seeing his homeroom teacher, Oksana Volodymyrivna, the boy apologized for being late and expressed his gratitude that the others had waited for him. Oksana Volodymyrivna invited her last pupil to the center of the classroom and said; 

- “Childrens, this is your 14th and last classmate, Petro. Please treat him with respect, kindness, and honor so that our class becomes the friendliest group in our school!
strings.FUK_events.4.a: After that, the Whole Class Eagerly Began to Befriend Petro
strings.FUK_events.8.d:
Since we are currently continuing to work closely with reformist nazis, why not use the same approach with other forces that have dealt with them in the past, such as the ROA(Russian Liberation Army)? At present, we do not have sufficient information about these reformers and do not know their motives, which poses the risk that they may deceive us and drive us into even greater dependence from Germania. At the same time, decisive opposition to their intentions will result in us losing the support of the german elite, so what should we do?

In fact, the hetman was not the only one in this position. ROA general Andrey Vlasov is also in similar conditions in the east, the leader of the russian warlord state, located mostly near Samara city, had to deal with germans most part of post-war period. Danylo, no matter how much he hated the bolsheviks, was ready to compromise with Russian collaborators at a time when it was so necessary for the Hetmanate. Although the general already had one foot in the grave, Vlasov sent a reply from his capital in Samara, agreeing to provide all the details of his flirtations over the years with all supporters of nazi ideology in exchange for comprehensive assistance.

The essence of the agreement is the permanent presence of the Hetmanate volunteer corps in case of wars by the ROA for the unification of Russia. As soon as the ROA unifies Russia, the Hetmanate will be able to recall the volunteer contingent back to Ukraine. In return, former Russian collaborators promise to immediately recognize Ukrainian Hetmanate independence and, after unification, to begin fruitful cooperation aimed at developing a non-german economic sphere of influence in Europe, Asia, and other countries. In addition to this, we should consider the benefits for our newly formed armed forces of studying mountain warfare in the Urals, warfare in the swamps and cold tundras of Siberia, and warfare in conditions of lack of infrastructure in the Far East of Russia.

In Danylo's personal opinion, russian wars for unification with the support of one of the most attractive forces for the hetmanist movement, the ROA, will be beneficial in the long term. Although there are fears in the government that after the death of Vlasov, his successor will not want to confront the Nazis and will ultimately refuse to fulfill the agreements after the unification of Russia. Now all that remains is to weigh all the options and make a final decision...
strings.FUK_events.8.a: ROA are Soldiers, and They Don't Forget the Assistance Provided by Hetmanists During the Wars
strings.FUK_events.8.b: The Russian Empires Have Always Acted Against Us, Nothing Will Change After Their Unification
strings.FUK_events.5.d:
To our surprise, the national-bolsheviks, who had been rebuilding the country throughout the years of nazi occupation and who had suffered a crushing defeat in the Ukrainian Civil War, began an underground resistance movement.

Even without their leader, they continue their subversive activities against the established Hetmanate, spreading their propaganda among the working class, agitating them to resist the new government and fight for workers' rights.We must deploy the newly formed State Guard ( SG ) security forces to combat this threat before the fire of revolution aimed at overthrowing our legitimate government plunges Donbas into yet another bloody uprising.
strings.FUK_events.5.a: Isn't Bolshevism a Relic of the Past?
strings.FUK_events.3.d: After decades of Nazi rule, Ukraine's administrative apparatus remained in a state of disrepair. Following the flight of key corrupt regional officials after the Hetman coup, we were left with administrators who created an extraordinary administrative burden. In essence, we hold power thanks to the forces of the militarized “Free Cossacks” and a political coalition with Stus's patriots and a small number of Dziuba's supporters. Our hetmanate is saved from collapse by the population's fatigue from the civil war, as well as the prestige of Danylo Skoropadskyi in the eyes of the common people, who are tired of the empty talk of the communists, hatred of the Nazis, and the decline of the local nationalist sentiments.
strings.FUK_events.3.a: Let's deal with all the problems one by one.
strings.FUK_events.17.t: The question of the Galician lands
strings.FUK_events.17.d:
This morning, a letter from the self-proclaimed “hetman” of Ukraine was delivered to the Führer's office. After Martin opened it, he immediately thought it was some kind of bad joke, but after reading the demands, he understood the situation. The Ukrainians, who during the state of emergency in the Reich, without permission, seized the territories of our protectorate - the General Government in Galicia, want to keep the lands they have gained!

- “It's amazing where the slaves found the courage to demand recognition of their right to control the territory of the Reich. It's just mind-boggling...” Bormann's philosophy was interrupted by Walter Hewel, Hitler's former foreign minister, who came in to ask if everything was all right because of the loud noise.

- “My Führer, is everything all right? What surprised you so much?”

- “Ah, it's you, Walter. Here, read these fables. They're from the ukrainian ”hetman“. Can you believe it?”

- “So they've decided to become something like a second Reichskommissariat named ”Hetmanate“? That's interesting, I don't see any reason to refuse. I advise you to discuss this with the Minister of Economy. We don't need slaves from lands so far away, but their resources...”

- “Actually, I wanted to write a refusal to teach them a lesson and show them that no slave dares to set conditions for revising the territories of the Thousand-Year Reich! However, I think your opinion is also valid, I will ask the Reichsminister what he thinks about it, thank you very much for your advice Walther Hewel.”
strings.FUK_events.17.a: “My will is as uncompromising as Hitler's!”
strings.FUK_events.17.b: “Our mega-corporations will be satisfied with this decision”
strings.FUK_events.18.d:
On this ordinary working morning, Albert Speer, Führer of the Greater Germanic Reich, pored over a report sent by his diplomats from Kyiv. Yes, that's right, Skoropadsky's Hetman government had requested a “plebiscite” in Galicia. In reality, it was offering billions of marks in exchange for the transfer of Galicia, granting it autonomous status with free and unrestricted activity for German megacorporations.

Although this decision would undoubtedly allow us to finance the rapid restoration of the country and get rid of the scars of war in the short term, Speyer understood the risks of agreeing to such a “plebiscite”.These hetmans may perceive this as both weakness and mercy. However, by agreeing to these conditions, we will be able to lull the belligerence of these cossacks and get rid of the hidden hostile sentiments of Ukrainian slaves with one concession. The rebels have shown how easily they can overthrow our local administrations during any German crisis. In addition, the transfer of all of Galicia to the Ukrainians, which the crushed Poles still claim, will allow us to further quarrel these two nations and distance ourselves from their hatred towards us.In this way, we will get rid of ethnic problems in the Reich.

However, the Führer's report contained another request from Danylo Skoropadskyi himself. In an additional letter, he pledged to continue payments for Galicia and the remnants of the Reichskommissariat Ukraine, because, in his words, “Ukraine, as a European state, should not be divided between two competing governments”.Albert did not know how to respond to this request. A week passed, and all of his reichsministers asked him to refuse Skoropadsky's request to transfer Brest, but why mistakenly cling to something that had proven unviable without the help of the Reich?If the Reichskommissariat turned out to be such a corrupt structure that it failed to suppress poorly armed rebels, what would prevent those same rebels from finishing what they had started and finally eliminating the remnants of the Reichskommissariat Ukraine?The final answer remains with the new Führer himself.
strings.FUK_events.18.a: There is no point in clinging to corrupt, rotten institutions. Grant all requests from the Hetmanate.
strings.FUK_events.18.b: Let Brest-Litowsk remain a point of influence on Kyiv!

strings.FUK_events.9.d:
“The new year of our extremely useful program for society continues to develop and exceed our expectations from last year.

The time has come when our Ukrainian individual farmers are able to independently manage their farms and profit from them. Food produced on agricultural land, in villages, and in state cooperatives is sold on the market, and a significant percentage of these transactions goes to the budget. However, the costs of developing agricultural entrepreneurship are not low.

It's also impossible not to notice periodic monthly jumps in inflation, which isn't and won't be stable, so it is necessary to be cautious about investments, possibly limiting them for some time. The problem of increasing ukrainian consumption of grain crops and other foodstuffs is becoming more and more acute. The state's task is to at least maintain parity between food production and consumption, so that it is not necessary to purchase foreign products.

Despite the constant increase in annual consumption demands of the population, our economy continues to grow rapidly. Our ministry has prepared a new action program to combat inflation, but in return we will be forced to reduce state support for agricultural cooperatives.”

- With respect to His Excellency the Hetman, Minister of the “BreadBasket” Program, Mykhailo Starozhetskyi.

According to statistics, we have improved agricultural production methods, increased our grain reserves, and it appears that they have almost covered all of our national needs.

However, the process of eliminating external influence on our domestic food security sector is still far from its logical conclusion. We hope that in a few years we will be able to fully and, most importantly, independently feed our large and ever-growing population, despite the restrictions of the Second Treaty of the Brest-Litowsk Agreement.

There are many other positive aspects of the state program ”BreadBasket“. The main one is the increase in local GDP in the regions, which contributes to the growth of the economic power and independence of the Hetmanate. In addition, we can highlight the creation of thousands of new jobs, mainly in villages, as well as the prospects for selling our products to our neighbors, and in a few years, to all of Europe and beyond!

However, we are currently facing difficulties in providing all our citizens with basic necessities, such as insufficient supply of products to remote areas, including Crimea, due to logistical problems. We recommend increasing the size of the garrison on the peninsula due to a new wave of ”bread protests“ by dissatisfied local radical germans over our prioritization of feeding ukrainians first.”

Thanks to the nearly completed construction of a trade hub that will begin in the port of Sevastopol, in a year we will open profitable trade routes with Africa, both Americas, and Asia. In the near future, in just 5-10 years, we will not lag behind the leading countries - the USA or Japan - economically, but will catch up with them! Glory to the Hetmanate, long live Skoropadsky!”

During the reform of our air force structure, we faced the urgent problem of a lack of domestic aircraft. The soviet, pre-war aircraft we had are outdated and cannot keep up with the times, lagging behind by more than a decade. Currently, all of our aircraft are based on german models of the 1950s, purchased recently.

Our pilots insist on increasing funding for the production of domestic aircraft for our air force. These aircraft are manufactured in ukrainian design bureaus based on advanced german aircraft. However, our financiers, who have barely recovered from the increase in funding for the ground forces, are opposed to increased funding.

Our budget is not elastic, and in the near future, our economy will not be able to compete with superpowers in terms of funding the armed forces. In the end, if you want to improve something, you have to neglect something else...

The oil crisis, which has plagued politicians all over the world for almost a year, has had a strong impact on our country. Our government obediently accepted all the Hetman's proposals to introduce a ban on the sale of oil and increase domestic oil production in all areas where possible. The crisis has temporarily slowed down our GDP growth and has also sufficiently depleted our fuel resources.

Now, it seems, we have gone from a deficit to a surplus, our neighbors, although wary of us, pragmatically buy our oil, which is in surplus. Although it will take a long time to fully recover, we are sure that we have now succeeded in our mission - to start successful ukrainian oil autarky.
strings.FUK_events.22.a: We Live Not For Tomorrow, But For Today
strings.FUK_proxy_events.1.d:
Ukrainian rebels in Transcarpathia have secured control over all Ukrainian villages, cities and mountains, ready for further integration with the homeland! The leader of the insurgents, our general Mykola Tarnovyi, is joyfully greeted at Khreschatyk in the capital with a military victory parade. There are already plans to promote him to the role of field marshal for such a great victory.

Indeed, it is difficult to overestimate our successful operation to return such a distant and long-forgotten ukrainian region. The germans, and especially the hungarians, were already sure that this region would never be ukrainian again, but we proved the opposite, proving to the whole world that despite the present, we remember our past roots, past generations, and all the unsuccessful attempts to build ukrainian statehood. Let this serve as a lesson that we will not put up with any manifestations of oppression of ukrainians near our borders!
strings.FUK_proxy_events.1.a: Transcarpathia is a Part of Ukraine From Now On And Forever!
strings.FUK_proxy_events.2.t: The Collapse of the RK Kaukasien Due to Mass Uprisings
strings.FUK_proxy_events.2.d:
What happened was what the entire ethnic population of the Caucasus was waiting for - their hated Reichskommissariat began to fall apart. This is their chance to regain their long-lost independence, and we will help them with that. Georgians and azerbaijanis put up a full-fledged fight. We could start helping them both, but the americans have clearly outlined their interest in helping Azerbaijan, and we, in turn, will provide help to rebel Georgia, with which our ideological interests coincide.

To our great surprise, Japan, with whom we maintained good relations since the confrontation with Hungary over Transcarpathia, decided to help the Germans in suppressing the uprisings. They are clearly acting for pragmatic purposes, let's hope this will not affect the strengthening of the RK position in the region and will not result in the defeat of the uprisings.
strings.FUK_proxy_events.2.a: If that Doesn't Destroy RK, What Will?
strings.FUK_proxy_events.2.b: For the National Liberation of Georgia!
strings.FUK_proxy_events.3.t: Complete Loss of Control of RK Kaukasien Over Azerbaijan
strings.FUK_proxy_events.3.d:
So, Azerbaijan is rising with our help, this is a great success! For the most part, this was facilitated by the oil crisis, which drove the Kaukasus into a deep national crisis, as a result of which the slave population broke the long-term shackles based on forced labor for the benefit of the hated Reich. Our task is to contribute in any way to ensuring the victory of azerbaijanis in their struggle for liberation!

Also, we observe the current lack of interest on the part of other superpowers in the Kaukasian War. Whether it is due to economic troubles due to the crisis, or purely out of fear of the defeat of a single Azerbaijani uprising against the entire Reichskommissariat, official Washington and Tokyo do not comment on this uprising in any way. Therefore, it is only in our national interests to ensure the weakening of the Reichskommissariat in the region and to halve oil production by the Unity Pact for the viability of the Reich's military capabilities.
strings.FUK_proxy_events.3.a: Piece by Piece And the Rotten Structure Will Fall!

With a significant share of our spending on fleet building, the question arose of the feasibility of meeting these expenses. On the one hand, our new class of ukrainian sailors requires leaving the current costs for fleet building. No one knows what will happen tomorrow, if Turkey suddenly declares war on us, for example, we will be completely destroyed at sea due to the small number of ships. This position is completely justified, because in the future rivalry with the nazis, their Kriegsmarine will be able, by putting pressure on Turkey, to pass into the Black Sea and start shelling our coast.

strings.FUK_Andriy_Bilopolskyi_hog_desc:
Head of Government
Hetmanist Movement
--------------
A graduate of the Commercial Institute in Kyiv (1918), Ukrainian politician and assistant to the Hetman, Bilopolskyi built a brilliant career for himself. As one of the founders of the Ukrainian Union of Farmers-Statists, which in the late 1930s was transformed into the Union of Hetmanites-Statesmen of Ukraine, he later published nine issues of the irregular magazine “Plow and Sword”, aimed at the younger generation of Ukrainians. As a result of his consistent and dedicated work, he became the most influential and trusted person in the Hetman's circle.

In his 1960 manifesto “Call for Unity”, he proposed soft, pragmatic cooperation between the government of the Ukrainian People's Republic in exile and the Hetmanists for peaceful pro-Ukrainian changes in the structures of the Reichskommissariat. Due to the negative response from the exiles and Andriy Melnyk's negative attitude towards the repression of loyal Ukrainians, the Germans did not repress the Hetman's supporters in Ukraine. Therefore, through trial and failures, Andriy Bilopolskyi now occupies an honorable place alongside the Hetman in governing the country, and many members of the UNRA follow his manifesto for harmonious coexistence in the new Ukrainian Hetmanate.
strings.FUK_Oleksander_Semenenko_eco_desc:
Economic Minister
Hetmanist Movement
--------------
From 1917 to 1922, Oleksandr collaborated with the Central Rada, studied at Odessa University, and worked as an editor for a newspaper in Yelisavetgrad. After the failure of the Ukrainian Revolution, he settled in Kharkiv and, in May 1925, became a member of the Kharkiv Bar Association.

During the German administration, he worked within the Reichskommissariat; in Kharkiv, he was initially the deputy mayor (Oberbürgermeister) O. Kramarenko's advisor on legal matters, and from 1942 onward, he himself held the position of mayor (Oberbürgermeister) (1942–1949). Due to his opposition to the Generalplan Ost policy, which reached its peak in Slobozhanshchyna in the late 1940s, Semenenko resigned “of his own accord”.

In the following decade, he became a staunch supporter of Hetmanism, moved to the Reich, and became the head of the Colonial Office for the care of Ukrainian workers deported to Reich for forced labor. After the end of the Western Russian War in Eastern Europe, he returned to the Reichskommissariat Ukraine to be of greater service to the increasingly popular Hetmanist movement. For all these contributions to the welfare of Ukrainians abroad and at home, Oleksandr was appointed Minister of Economy in the restored Ukrainian Hetmanate.
strings.FUK_militarized_free_cossacks_1_desc:
With Skoropadsky's proposal approved, Horlis's UNRA ranks are reinforced with `cossack` militia formations to provide security and civil order for the local population. Also they have to carry out rapid raids on enemy territory under the guise of locals.

In the war for the freedom of the Ukrainian people, those fighters is prepared to use all methods of warfare.
strings.FUK_militarized_free_cossacks_desc: Due to ambitious economic reforms in the Hetmanate, we had to reduce the maintenance of the Free Cossack divisions. Of course, we saved millions in expenses for maintaining the largest military organization, separate from the Armed Forces of the Hetmanate, but this seriously undermined their combat capabilities.
strings.FUK_militarized_free_cossacks_2_desc:
Nothing stands still, and over time, the militarized units of the “Free Cossacks” proved their courage, bravery, faith, and loyalty to the Hetmanate. Undoubtedly, their combat history of service to our homeland will inspire future generations of Ukrainians to revive the long-lost cossack traditions.

What began as a means of gaining power by Danylo Skoropadskyi in 1964 now serves as the cornerstone of Ukrainian statehood. If future enemies of the Ukrainian Hetmanate encroach on its territorial integrity and sovereignty, they will face fierce resistance and regret their aggression a hundredfold.

Day and night, the Hetman Guard of the “Free Cossacks” will defend every meter of the Ukrainian Hetmanate border.

Even when the lives of these soldiers are at stake, they will not hesitate to give their lives for an independent Ukraine
strings.FUK_the_second_brest_litowsk_treaty_desc:
For the second time in a century, we are forced to comply with German demands for our own survival. This time it is even worse, because we remain the “breadbasket” in the eyes of the Führer...

We must change the terms of this unequal agreement as quickly as possible
strings.FUK_the_second_brest_litowsk_treaty_with: The Second Treaty of Brest-Litowsk - Bormann's Vision

Most likely, we will have to endure these conditions until Martin Bormann's death. Unfortunately, these conditions will continue to affect our economy, although they are better than the initial ones. We can better plan our remaining food supplies and live for another month, then a year, then five years...

Damn, how long will this last... let's hope our reserves will last until the middle of 1970s...
The Second Treaty of Brest-Litowsk - Speer's Vision

Finally, we managed to sign terms that are beneficial to both parties! Instead of supplying 100% of agricultural products, we provide 65%, and the rest is replaced with cash payments. Of course, this will hit the budget in the long run, but right now it's the best option. We avoided the risk of famine, and that's what matters most!

Let's enjoy the years ahead, they should be bright for our citizens!
strings.FUK_new_taxation_policy_desc:
Under the terms of the second Brest-Litovsk Treaty, the Hetmanate is obliged to transfer large quantities of agricultural products to the Reich, which increases the burden on our already crippled economy. Since we cannot simply take food from the population by force, we provide monetary compensation for such actions. However, this causes the national debt to grow too quickly.

In just two months of the agreement with the Nazis, our total debt has increased by 7% of total GDP, and what will happen in a year? It is precisely because of the threat of financial collapse that we will have to increase taxes for the population. This will cause poverty, but it is a necessary evil.
strings.FUK_shady_situation_desc: Life under the boot of the Greater Germanic Reich does not promise us independent politics and life within the framework of an enslaved Europe. This fact casts a long shadow over our subjectivity. As long as a united Europe exists in the iron grip of the Reich, we will not be able to escape the negative consequences of this state of affairs.
strings.FUK_romanian_terrorists_desc:
After the expulsion of the Romanian occupation administration, groups of Romanian-Moldovan terrorists remain in the region of former Transnistria, causing harm to the new Ukrainian administration in these lands.

This coalition of hostile forces is based on ethnic hatred of Ukrainians, but what if we win the Moldovans over to our side by promising them their own state in the future, independent of Ukraine, Romania, or any other power? So far, they are not optimistic about creating their own state, but our special services will begin the process of deliberately sowing discord between these two nations, based on historical facts of confrontation with the Romanians and friendship with the Ukrainians.
strings.FUK_reconstruction_of_semi_ruin: Reconstruction After a Period of Semi-Ruin
strings.FUK_reconstruction_of_semi_ruin_desc:
Our great and beautiful Ukraine has suffered even greater destruction than during the West Russian war almost a decade ago. Although these destructions are not as critical and horrifically large-scale as during Operation Barbarossa in the early 1940s, this civil war is called a “semi-ruin” by the current generation. The very fact that Ukrainians have been at war with each other for the past months worries the hetman too much in these dark times.

In order to heal the heart, it is necessary to carry out a comprehensive diagnosis of the entire structure of Ukrainian statehood. Those governmental and administrative structures of the Reichskommissariat damaged or destroyed during the civil war will no longer fulfill the function and role they played during the Reich's rule. Absolutely everything that we will rebuild during the recovery period will serve the hetman's cause to strengthen Ukraine and turn it into an independent player in Europe. With the destruction of the old one, we will build our native land, which will surely last longer than the tyrannical Koch Reichskommissariat!
strings.FUK_stbl_idea_desc:
Although distant European colleagues from the Unity Pact might assume that Germania stands to benefit the most from the Second Treaty of Brest-Litowsk, the true state of affairs and the progress of the Ukrainian Hetmanate's fulfillment of its obligations are being monitored by none other than Pieter Heerema.

In fulfilling his treaty-mandated role as leader of the Brest-Litowsk Treaty Zone, he reaps the rewards of his new position. He has no army of his own, not even a police force, which allows him to save the meager state budget in every way possible. His sole mission, which he will continue to carry out diligently, is to ensure an uninterrupted supply of food and food security in the Reich in exchange for a future of hunger for the Ukrainians. Undoubtedly, as long as his fiefdom exists, the self-proclaimed Ukrainian Hetman can forget about the well-being of his nation forever, since the stipulated food quotas will not fill themselves...
strings.FUK_protesting_germans_desc: It seems that not all of our recent enemies in the civil war realize their defeat, including the Germans. Fortunately, the most radical Nazis died in the war against us, and those who remain are demoralized. We expect their resistance to our authority to end this year.
strings.FUK_proletarian_threat_desc: It seems that Shumskyi ideas about a national-bolshevik Ukraine SSR, unfortunately, did not die out with the defeat in the civil war. In addition to the devastation of our country, we need to identify and eliminate every single center of insurgent, unacceptable dissident socialist movements in our state. Because if we allow them to continue to exist, we risk losing part or all of the Ukrainian Donbas area in the future.

strings.FUK_proletarian_threat_aftermath_desc: We managed to break the backbone of the national-bolshevik threat to our authority in Donbas, but we did not fully deal with the officers and rank-and-file members of this underground resistance.Now these elements have exposed our secret agents and fled to dense forests and impassable terrain without roads, lying low. It will take a long time before we can track them down again and eliminate this movement once and for all.
strings.FUK_north_crimean_canal_project_progress: 6 Stage:Water Route From Kahovka to Kerch
7 Stage:Water Route From Kahovka to Kerch
strings.FUK_north_crimean_canal_final_project_de:
As a result of months of work by hundreds of workers, builders, technicians, and planners, we have finally completed the major construction of the North Crimean Canal, which should put an end to the humanitarian crisis on the peninsula.

Now there is a railway and specially equipped road routes to get to the peninsula, and a sea connection from Mykolaiv to Sevastopol has also been established. There is also plenty of fresh water and we do not spend extra funds from the state budget on the expensive maintenance of Crimea. This is the first real ukrainian economic breakthrough, and our efforts have become useful not only for Crimea, but also for the international authority of our Hetmanate!
strings.FUK_ger_embargo_desc:
Due our active foreign policy activities directed against the Reich, the Führer has declared a comprehensive embargo on us. They apply both to the conduct of any entrepreneurial activity and to doing business in the territory of the Unity Pact.

Because of these restrictions, german entrepreneurs do not want to develop business or any economic transactions in our country, because they will face restrictive consequences from the Reich. In essence, we have fallen into economic isolation, and all our attempts to restore economic ties with other members of the Unity Pact are met with fierce resistance from Germania.

In view of these sanctions, we could cancel our obligations to supply goods to the Reich and to dissolve the Second Treaty of Brest-Litowsk. However, the Führer has clearly emphasized that any action to change or terminate the current version of this agreement will lead to the beginning of military action between the two countries.
strings.FUK_bad_transnistria_supply_bases_desc:
The war in Transnistria is the worst war in all of Europe since the end of World War II in terms of logistics. The romanian government neglected the logistical unification of the region, having built only the “Bucharest-Odesa” road during the entire period of control over Transnistria, which indicates an unwillingness to develop the newly acquired lands.

Due to this, the war in Transnistria is proceeding very slowly, with at best one side taking a few dozen kilometers in a few weeks. That is why both sides suffer enormous casualties in the battles, and leading military experts compare this war with asian ones, where there are long-term partisan conflicts, such as in Vietnam or Malaysia.
strings.FUK_improved_navy_forces: Bring the Black Sea Fleet Back to Life
strings.FUK_allocate_small_budget_to_navy: Small State Subsidization of the Fleet
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.1.desc:
After the unpopular politician and collaborator of the previous Nazi administration, Oleksandr Ohloblyn, unexpectedly won the rigged first elections in Ukraine's history, ukrainians took to the streets in protests and demonstrations against the unpopular new government.In parallel with the mass protests, many military personnel joined the population, inspired by the political coalition formed between the United Struggle and the UHS, and began an open rebellion, also refusing to recognize the elections.

As a result of this political upheaval, Ohloblyn was arrested by Free Cossack units, and Pavlo Skoropadskyi's successor, Danylo Skoropadskyi, was elected the new leader of the state, with the title of hetman.The coup was condemned by the Reich, which had high hopes for easy submission from the presidential administration, but now it seems the germans will face resistance to their desire to be tied to the former breadbasket.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.1.a: Breadbasket of the Reich Is Now a Standalone Player?
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.2.desc:
Breaking news from Kyiv, the capital of the Ukrainian People's Republic, President Ivan Dziuba, successfully elected by the people in the country's first elections, has signed a resignation under pressure from the military.After an unsuccessful attempt to arrest the popular general Taras Bulba-Borovets, the right hand of Vasyl Stus from United Struggle, president provoked the overthrow of his government.

It`s also reported that units of the “Free Cossacks”, led by Danylo Skoropadskyi, acted preemptively and managed to arrive at parliament before the end of the ceremony electing Vasyl Stus as the new president, which resulted in the establishment of the Third Hetmanate.

The new hetmanate announced that the elections, as well as democratic processes in the country, would be suspended indefinitely. The US government condemned this coup, which had hoped for the flourishing of what might be Europe's last democracy and wanted to establish diplomatic relations with the Ukrainian People's Republic.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.2.a: This is how socialist democracies die
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.3.desc:
The recent terror of the hungarian authorities against the renewed ukrainian dissident movement in Transcarpathia, which was accompanied by physical violence against the ukrainian minority, led to an uprising in the region! The hungarian government started the “Transcarpathian Blitz” operation, which aims to completely suppress the Transcarpathian rebels in a matter of weeks.

The rebels were led by the partisan general Mykola Tarnovyi, which indicates the indirect involvement of the Ukrainian Hetmanate in the uprising. The Greater Germanic Reich took a wait-and-see position, official Germania calls on both sides to sit down at the negotiating table to prevent further escalation of the conflict.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.3.a: Isn't the Region of Transcarpathia Hungarian?
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.4.desc:
The hetmanists government announced a “Special Liberation Operation” against Hungary aimed at liberating Transcarpathia, which has been under the control of the Kingdom of Hungary since 1939. Ukrainians expect to end the war, which, according to military experts, may drag on in 2-3 weeks.

German diplomats condemned this invasion, calling it “barbaric” and one that would violate the European New Order that had been formed since the end of the West Russian War. Skoropadskyi said that until the hungarians agreed to accept the terms of the Hetmanate, the war would continue. The hungarians, on the other hand, hope for decisive action from Germania to end hostilities.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.5.desc:
Throughout the Unity Pact, there are alarming news from the most unstable Reichskommissariat Kaukasien about a rebellion that turned into an organized Azerbaijani uprising! The authorities of the Reichskommissariat announced a general mobilization and imposed martial law, beginning a brutal suppression of the resistance of the local population. At that time, azerbaijanis are fighting to the last breath for the restoration of their statehood.

The Azerbaijani cause is supported diplomatically by the US government, and militarily by the Ukrainian Hetmanate, which shocked Germania bureaucrats and politicians. Now it is already clear the impossibility of further warm relations between the Greater Germanic Reich and the Hetmanate, because from this moment they are now rivals in the Cold War.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.5.a: It Was Only a Matter of Time, Accelerated by the Hetmanate...
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.6.desc:
Unbelievably, but relatively calmed down since the end of the West Russian war, the Kaukasus began to collapse due to the global oil crisis and increased quotas from Germania! However, now it seems that the inability of the state structure of the RK to destroy every separatist movement in the region through terror, hard labor and hunger is becoming clear.

The most numerous groups of the Kaukasus - georgians and azerbaijanis - rose up.This development attracted the attention of all the key players of the Cold War, and they already began to provide assistance to one or another side in the war. Therefore, it is appropriate to conclude that this is not just the suppression of rebel movements - this is a real proxy war of superpowers to expand their sphere of influence!
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.6.a: “Those Who Struggle Will Win the World”, Huh?
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.22.desc:
Is the Ukrainian Hetmanate now a fully-fledged new Empire? Today, the whole world was surprised by this incredible turn of events, as Danylo Skoropadskyi, bearing the monarchical title of “Hetman” , united the main ukrainian-populated lands, including even the Kuban region.

This absurd reality, which even the Greater Germanic Reich could not have imagined, has finally come to pass thanks to Skoropadsky's thoughtful and purposeful policy of undermining German influence in Eastern Europe. However, there are currently no direct signs of a military response from Führer Bormann to the creation of an empire that does not obey the established New Order, due to the consequences of the oil crisis.

The Reich has already applied all possible economic sanctions against the Hetmanate to exacerbate the local crisis. Whether the Hetman will dare to renounce the Second treaty of Brest-Litowsk or not, only time will tell.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.22.a: New Ukraine Directly Challenges the Bormann Patience
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.23.desc:
The latest news has shocked the ukrainian diaspora around the world. What began as a “pro-ukrainian authoritarianism with controlled parliamentarism” has now turned into an open fascist authoritarian dictatorship built on the cult of personality of Danylo Skoropadskyi.

After the unexpected end of the UHS coalition with United Struggle and the arrest of it's leader Vasyl Stus, as well as the closure of parliament, Hetmanate has de-facto become a truly dictatorship, completely controlled by one person. There are reports of protests and demonstrations in Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro, Vinnytsia, Lutsk against the dissolution of parliament. However, these actions are quickly suppressed by the Special Department and the Free Cossack troops.

Given the rapid and widespread arrests of prominent political opponents, republican agitators, independently journalists, as well as the complete state control over the AFH, the likelihood of removing the hetman from power is negligible.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.23.a: Hetmanate Returns to It's Historical Roots
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.24.t: {get_newspaper_header}The Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate joins the CSB
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.24.desc:
It has been officially confirmed that the day before yesterday at the Yalta summit, a delegation from the Russian Republic was present - to everyone's surprise. Following hours of negotiations between the two sides behind closed doors, hidden from cameras and journalists, a declaration of comprehensive strategic partnership was signed by the prime ministers of both countries.

The Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate renounces its neutral status, as well as all obligations it had assumed, as a result of the signing of The Second Treaty of Brest-Litowsk. This morning, Hetman {fuk_getleader} confirmed the country's shift in geopolitical orientation toward the East and its de facto accession to the {sam_getleader}'s Collective Security Bloc. This “rash and irreversible” decision enraged the German Führer {ger_getleader}; numerous unconfirmed reports from many high-ranking German officials indicate that, from now on, the entire Unity Pact will begin mobilizing and preparing all their resources for the inevitable war.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.24.a: The Die Was Cast For an Irreversible War.
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.24.b: Let's Throw Off the Yoke of Oppression - This Time For Sure!
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.24.c: Ha-Ha-Ha, Those Nazi scumbags have Another Front!
strings.FUK_Hetmanate.24.d: They Haven't Learned Anything From Their History With the Russians.
strings.FUK_the_hetmans_coup_once_again_desc:
The Ukrainian People Republic, just as it did almost half a century ago, failed to live up to the expectations of the ukrainian people. Amid a wave of demonstrations and protests, the hetman's heir, Danylo Skoropadskyi, staged a coup, just as his father, Pavlo, had done back in 1918.

This time, Ukraine is increasingly neglected, as the months of bloody fighting during the civil war and two decades of Nazi terror have left deep scars on the nation. The hetman task is to heal and capitalize on this lost potential and prove to the world what an independent, self-sufficient Ukraine is capable of. Or rather, the third Ukrainian Hetmanate has been restored.
strings.FUK_aid_in_recovery_from_collaborators: Ask Collaborators to Support the Recovery Period
strings.FUK_aid_in_recovery_from_collaborators_d: It is astonishing, yet we have managed to win over the greater part of that wretched Ohloblin's support base-the collaborators. The elite, shaped through the long years of the Reichskommissariat's dominion over Ukrainian lands, have grown disillusioned with their paranoid leader and crossed to our side. This social stratum, if approached wisely, can become the key to the swift restoration of the Hetmanate!
strings.FUK_raise_taxation_desc: Our economy, in the aftermath of the civil war, lies in a pitiful state. The process of rebuilding demands immense resources - an exhausting strain on the treasury. However, the burden is made even heavier by the need to rebuild a country that suffered severe destruction following the civil war. We have no choice left for securing additional revenue now but to raise taxes by half again.
strings.FUK_appease_the_germans_desc:
After years of the Reich's campaigns to settle eastern Europe with ethnic germans, we have inherited an artificially created dilemma - a sizable german population. Should we let the germans keep their homes, tolerate their pro-nazi leanings, or oblige them to obey ukrainian law?“

We might leave things as they are and refrain from interfering with the local germans, at least for now, in exchange for their assurance that they will do no harm to our ukrainian people. Yet, if they disregard our wishes, they will be judged according to ukrainian law.
strings.FUK_resolve_an_industrial_issue_desc:
Our industrial sector has suffered greatly during the civil war. As fate would have it, the backbone of our industry developed along the banks of the Dnipro and in the east, within the basin of the Siverskyi Donets.

Now, eastern industry is in decline, and the local socialist workers-those few who remain-refuse to labor for what they call the “fascist junta”. This is why it is absolutely vital to deal seriously with these dissident elements and remove them from our factories. The welfare of the Hetmanate hangs in the balance!
strings.FUK_long_recovery_after_civil_war_desc:
The first signs of progress are here: repairs to the nation's key infrastructure hubs, sewage systems, and power grid are nearly complete. What remains is to provide housing for the homeless, extend financial support to businesses, and create new jobs to prevent further impoverishment of the people.

The first year will be difficult as we strive to restore our accustomed way of life, yet peaceful times lie ahead-and with them, the flourishing of the ukrainian nation!
strings.FUK_focus_on_the_welfare_of_ukrainians_d: Our attention must be firmly fixed on the ukrainian population. For it is solely thanks to the Ukrainian people that we hold the power to rule Ukraine. In courts of law, priority will be given to ukrainians. State aid shall be directed primarily to ukrainians. The dominant sway of all things german that has held for the past twenty years will be halted and replaced by the growth and ascendancy of all things ukrainian within our Hetmanate!
strings.FUK_focus_on_the_welfare_of_germans_desc: We must turn our focus to the german population. To ease ethnic tensions, we will not prohibit holding dual german citizenship in our country, nor will the german language be persecuted by our authorities. Through further compromises, we will reduce to zero the threat of hostile actions from the German population against our government, thereby securing the stability of our regime.
strings.FUK_fire_proletarian_elements_from_indus:
These bolshevik elements, who survived the flames of the civil war, are open supporters of Shumskyi! Day after day, these vermin undermine the Hetman's cause and fail to fulfill even half of their assigned quotas.

Our task is to replace them with people from the countryside. Though uneducated, they will not allow the complete collapse of industry in the Donbas, and in time, they may even surpass their bolshevik predecessors!
strings.FUK_hetman_economic_policy_desc:
As a result of the completion of the process of initial recovery of our torn country, we are moving to economic development. Hetman Danylo was presented with two plans for further economic development.

The easiest option is to leave everything as it is, the oligarchic structure that existed in the Reichskommissariat. In this case, we will simply replace the key figures in this system with those close to the hetman.

Another way is to start a completely new corporate economic model. We will take the basis of italian corporatism, however, with priority attention to the development of medium-sized businesses, forming a new “wealthy ukrainian peasant”.
strings.FUK_corporate_economy_desc:
Right today, we have an opportunity to build a new Ukrainian statehood from a clean slate, untainted by the ideologies and mistakes of the past. The structure of the Reichskommissariat showed us only its negative sides, aimed at demeaning the ukrainian people, which is simply intolerable! Instead of an oligarchic structure that squeezed all the juices out of our Motherland, we will adopt a corporate model of the economy.

Corporatism showed itself well on the example of the Italian and Japanese empires, allowing them to build a formidable military force in a short time, an economy resistant to global world crises, and ensure relatively low poverty in society. This, more than ever before, is what Ukraine needs, which for the past half century has not had peace and the right to independently deal with the economy. In the modern post-war world, it is not the power of arms that decides, but the economic power of individual developed countries, which will dictate the rules of the game for underdeveloped economies.
strings.FUK_economic_leap_forward_desc:
Economic planners, inspired (and alarmed) by Greater Germanic Reich rapid recovery, urge a ten-year sprint of heavy-industry expansion. They dub it the “Leap Forward!”, promising that blast furnaces from Dnipro to Donbas will thunder day and night until output matches Central Europe's.Mobilization orders will redirect labor from dust-bowl hamlets to factory barracks.

Engineers receive carte blanche to cannibalize derelict german plants for parts, while new hydroelectric dams tame the Dnipro's flow for turbines and smelters. However, speed has a price - environmental scars, exhausted workers and spiraling debts. But if the furnaces stay lit, Ukraine could shed its agrarian label in a single generation-and the Hetman's banners would fly over a true industrial power.
strings.FUK_stimulate_ukrainian_business_desc:
Stagnation drifts through workshops like winter fog: no credit, no consumers, no spark. Merchants board windows with resignation as unemployment scrawls graffiti on factory gates.The Hetmanate shall become both arsonist and firefighter. Tax holidays will ignite entrepreneurial fever, grants raining down on risk-takers vetted for political obedience. Bankers receive silent pardons for “creative lending” so long as the loans birth jobs by quarter's end.

A cacophony of startups bloom-some legitimate, many ill-starred-yet the streets buzz again with commerce. Inflation tingles at the edges, but optimism trumps caution; and with every new storefront the Hetmanate prints another poster boasting that tyranny and prosperity can indeed hold hands.
strings.FUK_strengthen_internal_independence_des:
Intelligence reports confirm german agents still haunt our ministries, steering contracts and silencing dissent. Hetman Danylo authorizes an internal purge: foreign “advisers” are recalled, import licenses re-evaluated, and domestic guilds granted first purchase rights.

A new Home Procurement Directorate audits every procurement above a few thousand hryvnias. It's mandate - ensure ukrainian steel arms ukrainian soldiers, ukrainian looms dress ukrainian children, and ukrainian taxes enrich ukrainian coffers.

Such self-assertion wins cheers from nationalists and ire from Germania financiers. Cutting certain cords may cost technical expertise-but each severed strand tightens our sovereignty.
strings.FUK_extract_minerals_desc:
Geologists have charted vast manganese, uranium and rare-earth deposits beneath the Kryvbas basin. Contracts are drafted for deep-shaft mines, processing mills and a continent-spanning rail spur to carry ore to smelters. Mining will flood state treasuries with royalties, powering tanks and tractors alike. State geologists map deposits with military precision; forced-labour battalions dynamite new tunnels under the eyes of engineers flown in from whichever ally can hold their nose the longest.

Life expectancy in the pits drops, while output targets climb. Ore pours onto railcars bound for smelters and export docks alike. The foreign exchange earned buys machinery, weapons, and a fleeting aura of invincibility. The Hetman must balance earth's bounty against its wounds. If handled wisely, the veins of the steppe will fund not only rearmament but the very modernization he dreams of.
strings.FUK_aristocratic_oligarchy_desc:
The post-war elite is a tangled jungle of petty barons and nouveau-riche scavengers, each clawing for a slice of Ukraine's half-rebuilt corpse. Their rivalries clog the courts, hobble investment, and ignite street brawls between hired goons. Left unmanaged, the chaos will devour whatever recovery we have eked out.

We thereby choose to domesticate, not decapitate. Ancient patents of cossack  nobility are dusted off and re-inked with fresh signatures. Titles once symbolic become collars of pure iron: loyalty buys hereditary tax exemptions while disloyalty forfeits estates to the crown. A council of magnate sharks convenes under armed guard, their agendas rewritten in the Hetman's hand.

These new oligarchs bow, for they must. In exchange for order they pledge a fixed tithe of profits and even private militias on call. The treasury fills, factories hum, and the populace glimpses a neo-feudal banner fluttering over a modern skyline: a promise of stability forged from gilded chains and proper delegation while the Ukrainian people are enslaved again, this time by their own.
strings.FUK_offices_construction_desc:
Chaos thrives in the cracks of butchered bureaucracy: forged nobility certificates, lost tax files, and ministries operating out of war-scarred basements. Governance by improvisation has the state stretched to its breaking point.

No more! Hetman decrees that concrete and steel shall rise where rubble once lay. A titanic government quarter shall sprout vaults, archives, and interrogation annexes. Each doorway of it will bristle with checkpoints. Paper is power-therefore the Hetman doubles the paper and chains to status of nobility it to secure desks.

Hereditary clerks drown in forms, but corruption suffocates alongside them. Statistics sharpen into weapons, feeding the regime real-time data on grain, guns, and grumblers. The people complain of endless queues, yet behind barred windows the machinery of state clicks into brutal efficiency.
strings.FUK_rebuilding_schools_desc:
War and occupation gutted our classrooms; roofs leak, textbooks rot, and children wander fields instead of lecture halls. Bombed classrooms echo with wind, and a generation of ukrainian children memorises war rather than arithmetic.

Illiteracy festers, threatening to rot any future industrial gains. The Ministry of Education unveils an emergency plan to rebuild schools brick by brick, village by village. Barrack-style schools sprout beside every factory, staffed by teachers who wield bayonet discipline and catechisms on loyalty.

Night classes conscript parents; libraries purge subversive texts in bonfires disguised as patriotic rallies.An educated populace is the cornerstone of any modern state, yet budgets are finite, and guns still compete with primers for every hryvnia. The Hetman must weigh tomorrow's minds against today's security.
strings.FUK_centralized_agricultural_reform_desc:
In the ongoing process of centralization of key sectors of the economy, perhaps the most important in the Hetmanate is the agricultural sector. This is not surprising, most of our ukrainian population works and lives in rural areas. The purposeful policy of the German occupation authorities attached ukrainians to the villages, deporting them from the cities, where german settlers settled en masse.

Here was the second main goal, besides the colonization of Eastern Europe, our enslaved people, working in the agricultural sector, delivered all the necessary food for the Reich, every day working without rights in the “Bread Basket” system of the Reich. Our mission is to take all the levers left by the german administrators in the agrarian sphere, otherwise The Second Treaty of Brest-Litowsk will put even more pressure on us, which risks turning into a new famine in our country, which is already suffering from various crises. Moreover, it will contribute to the fair and equal rationing of food among all sections of the population, and will ease our headache from The Second Treaty of Brest-Litowsk, the quota of which hetmanist government will now directly control.
strings.FUK_monopoly_on_industry_desc:
Dozens of small competitors hack at one another for dwindling resources, duplicating machinery and torching profit in spiteful price wars. The national economy bleeds from a thousand self-inflicted cuts.

The Hetman shall swing the cleaver. Rival plants are merged by decree, dissenting shareholders compensated with exile, and whole sectors are gifted to single “national champions” shackled to state oversight. Cartels report weekly to uniformed auditors; price floors are etched in stone tablets.

Efficiency surges as redundant furnaces dim and surviving ones roar. Innovation slows-but predictability returns, and with it the steady drumbeat of production quotas met and exceeded. One fist is easier to aim than many flailing hands.

Doubts linger: will these mammoths innovate or ossify? Nevertheless, centralizing profit streams under heavy Hetmanate oversight could bankroll modernization projects that free markets never touch.
strings.FUK_on_the_european_stage_desc:
With reconstruction underway, ambassadors urge the Hetmanate to shed provincial obscurity. A grand summit in Kyiv will unveil our new flag, currency and constitutional order before diplomats from Rome to Oslo.

The Hetmanate barges into Einheitspakt`s conference halls clad in polished jackboots. Treaties of friendship, telegraph accords and visa waivers lie ready for signatures. The message is simple: a sovereign, stable Ukraine stands open for business and willing to mediate between the fractured blocs of post-war Europe.

Recognition follows, grudging but real, public debut invites scrutiny. Fail to impress, and our efforts look like provincial pageantry. Succeed, and Ukraine reclaims the place history once denied her-pivoting her fate onto the continental chessboard.
strings.FUK_ensure_our_safety_desc:
Though the civil war's smoke has barely cleared, threats encircle Ukraine. The General Staff proposes an immediate security doctrine: fortify western passes, standardize small arms, and build an early-warning net along the Pollysian Marshes.

Simultaneously, diplomatic envoys will canvas Germania's fractious ministries, seeking guarantees-or at least time. Safety, the Hetman reminds his aides, is the fertile soil from which all reforms must grow. Adopting this posture forces hard resource choices, but without it, every factory and school stands on sand.
strings.FUK_listening_to_bormanns_demands_desc:
One faction of Hetman's court argues resistance is futile: obey Martin Bormann's directives, relinquish contentious tariffs, and accept joint garrison protocols. In exchange for this, the Führer promises border security and the restoration of german exports to our country.

Compliance stings patriotic pride, yet avoids the economic strangulation radiating from the Reich chancellery. Factories will hum under german contracts-even if our sovereignty dims beneath the swastika's shadow. But each concession breeds more demands. Today tariffs, tomorrow perhaps diplomatic autonomy or conscription quotas. The Hetman must weigh immediate relief against the slow bleed of national dignity.
strings.FUK_cooperation_with_speer_desc:
Bloody battles for power in the Greater Germanic Reich ended with the victory of the intellectual reformist faction of Albert Speer. A close friend of the previous Führer, who conquered almost all of Europe, differs considerably in his more compromising and pacifist views towards the enslaved peoples of the continent. Especially interesting is his position on slavery, which he will begin to implement later, including his policy in one way or another that will change the entire situation in Eastern Europe.

To our surprise, Führer Speer no longer seeks to oppress the ukrainian nation, and expresses pacifist views on our bilateral relations. Discreet german envoys offer technology exchange, joint production of locomotives and synthetic fuel plants - on the condition that new Ukraine proves to be an obedient but honest intermediary. Such a beneficial deepening of economic ties, according to the envoys, will contribute to a stable and prosperous situation in Eastern Europe, eliminating all misunderstandings and injustice, eradicating economic competition.

Engineers are drooling over the drawings of powerful turbines and modular housing that could revive our cities, which are proposed by german investors. In particular, if all the proposals of the envoys are accepted on our part, we are promised a critical benefit from the action of Zollverein, in which we will be an important member. This economic sphere promises to bring our total GDP to a level higher than during all the years of direct german occupation in a record time - in just 4 years! Perhaps it is time to reconcile the two ancient enemy nations, for the sake of building a new, thousand-year era of prosperity and peace in Europe?
strings.FUK_join_the_economic_sphere_of_evil: Join to the Economic Sphere of Evil
strings.FUK_join_the_economic_sphere_of_evil_des:
Total capitulation beckons: integrate fully into Großraumwirtschaft, aligning currencies, customs codes and industrial planning with Berlin. Western propaganda dubs it the “Economic Sphere of Evil”, though officials rarely say so aloud.

Integration guarantees raw-material purchases and modern machinery on credit. Yet fiscal levers will shift to Reichsbank hands, and Ukrainian workers may toil for foreign margins. Once inside, departure becomes near impossible. The decision marks a point of no return-from independence toward vassalhood garbed as partnership.
strings.FUK_propose_a_plebiscite_in_galicia_desc:
Armed conflict would bleed us, quiet ballots might bind Galicia without a shot. We will propose an internationally monitored plebiscite, promising inhabitants the right to choose between Poland or Hetmanate.

The gambit aims to showcase our commitment to self-determination, winning sympathy in foreign presses and undercutting banderite insurgents. Victory would legitimize our rule and even defeat would paint us as democrats rather than aggressors. Yet referendums can be gamed, and failure would embolden radicals. The Hetman gambles prestige on the conviction that Galician hearts beat ukrainian.
strings.FUK_the_question_of_galicia_desc:
Galicia, the borderland of languages and loyalties, remains an open wound. Germania hints that a peaceful settlement may finally determine our status in the Reich`s orbit. Hetman must decide: to give up it`s claims, offering to keep the acquired lands on the condition that german corporations dominate in the region, or to submit to the Führer`s demands to return all illegally acquired lands.

Abandoning one`s compatriots can cause internal outrage, branding the Hetmanship a puppet unwilling to protect it`s own. The dossier is getting thicker every day. Whatever path is chosen, the fate of Galicia will echo in every parish and brigade.
strings.FUK_join_the_european_sphere_desc:
Should Germania accept rapprochement, Ukrainian Hetmanate may enter the Zollverein customs bloc, dismantling tariffs across Central Europe. Grain, coal and machine parts would flow west; pharmaceuticals and precision tools east.

Membership promises market access but binds us to joint standards and dispute courts seated in Stuttgart. Some celebrate the dawn of prosperity, others decry financial vassalage beneath polished rhetoric. Still, embedding in continental trade webs could furnish the capital and trust necessary for a sovereign destiny - if we keep our footing amid the currents of german commerce.
strings.FUK_the_thousand_year_reich_reigns_in_eu: Thousand Year Reich Continue to Reign in Europe

All concessions are maded and alliances sealed, Germania formally recognizes Ukrainian Hetmanate as a perpetual satellite within the New Order. Ceremonies in the Reichstag hail an unbreakable bond cemented by blood, steel and ideology.

Our blue-gold flag hangs beside the Reichskriegsflagge; trophies of cooperation adorn museum halls. In Kyiv, skeptics whisper that the “Thousand Year Reich” may not last a thousand months-yet treaties inked today could chain tomorrow's generations.The Hetman must gaze into this mirror of eternity and decide whether reflected glory is worth the price of a captive future.
strings.FUK_cossacks_path_desc:
Some courtiers call on the hetman to manage foreign policy, reproducing the romantic spirit of the Zaporizhian Host. Military academies will revive the cossack drill, cavalry competitions and knightly oaths to serve the mace and the community. Abroad, especially in Europe, envoys will refer to ancient treaties on mutual defense against socialist tyranny, once again positioning Ukraine as Europe's steadfast frontier once more.

Domestically, veterans receive land grants and ranks in a reimagined Cossack Guard. Such rhetoric stirs hearts, but it can also worry our surrounding neighbors. Nevertheless, a credo rooted in honor, independence, and will can strengthen national unity better than any bureaucratic slogan.
strings.FUK_europeanization_desc:
Alternatively, Kyiv's reformers champion wholesale adoption of western institutions: independent judiciary, proportional representation and a charter of civil rights drafted in Vienna cafés. They promise foreign investment will flood in when Ukraine proves itself a “civilized” partner.

Lectures on constitutionalism echo through universities; newspapers praise german cooperatives and dutch water boards. Skeptics fear losing national character amid floods of imported ideas. But if successful, the path could knit Ukraine into Europe's prosperous core-trading cossack romance for the grander power of rule of law and controlled markets.
strings.FUK_prepare_impact_cells_desc: Determining our chances of becoming the fourth superpower, that is, a new player in the Cold War - are low. But we will try to compete with other superpowers for prestige in the world by setting up new proxy conflicts. Since they will be exclusively in our interests, let's focus on our neighbors.
strings.FUK_focus_on_our_homeland_desc: “A new Ukraine will arise - from the Sian River to the Caucasus” was the position of the integralists, nationalists of the OUN and banderists. Actually, this concept is literally impossible, since it requires fighting with all neighbors. We will implement our plan to enter the world stage precisely according to this concept, arranging proxy conflicts against neighbors who are allies of the Reich. They may interest other superpowers - accordingly, they will begin to reckon with us after our victory after victory!
strings.FUK_prospects_for_the_western_direction_: The western direction directly conflicts with the interests of the Hungarians - our old enemy and rival for control of Carpathian Ukraine. Since we agreed with Bormann on the redistribution of Galicia, we have free access to the border with Hungary. We are in the same Pact, as of now, so we will be able to transfer armed soldiers and a bunch of weapons there without hindrance when the time comes.
strings.FUK_southern_direction_desc: Our southern backyard was illegally occupied by Romania, without our approval! This is the real “Ukrainian Rhineland” and the time will come when we will correct this post-war mistake and erase this shameful page from our history once and for all!
strings.FUK_smoldering_fire_of_the_east_desc: The situation in the RK Kaukasien seems stable. After the end of West Russian War, all local partisan movements were suppressed, and those dissenting local tribes were forced to work at gunpoint in hard labor... It is time to start shaking the stability of the Kaukasus and turn it into the “Balkans” of the Reich sphere.
strings.FUK_report_on_the_situation_in_transnist: Reports from Romanian Transnistria indicate not the fading of the dissident movement, but rather its growth. After the instability in the region in 1964, we have the opportunity to further destabilize the internal situation. We can either influence Transnistria under the guise of investments or covert support for the rebels, so as to ultimately force Romania to withdraw from our ethnic lands.
strings.FUK_choosing_tools_desc: There is no point in negotiating with a party that suppressed the ukrainians of Bessarabia for half a century, and after the end of the World War II completely occupied our ethnic national territories! The end justifies the means, which is why we will aim for secret armed support for the rebels in order to better prepare them for the uprising. Although in the short term this option will lose to investment programs, as a result of the collapse of Transnistria, ukrainian rebels will be better armed!
strings.FUK_launch_investment_programs_desc:
An example of the desolation of the Transnistrian region is visible to the naked eye. For years, romanians ignored the economic development of the entire region, focusing only on the development of the Odesa port. This negatively affected the well-being of the population, which eventually became completely dependent on farming methods for survival and help from Odesa.

The worst thing in this situation was the ukrainian-moldovan competition for the monopoly on the control of agricultural land for growing crops. In order to eliminate conflict and try to lure some moldovans to our side, we will attract local investments in small business and the expansion of agriculture in the region.
strings.FUK_get_to_odesa_with_investments_desc: In the process of financing the key regions of Transnistria, the romanian administration allowed us to invest in Odesa. Of course, we will not refuse, although it will be more expensive, the prospects of obtaining an economically developed region in the future are too attractive.
strings.FUK_ignore_local_governors_desc:
Unexpectedly, the romanians managed to notice the bad intentions of the investment. Some prominent investor of ours slandered his subordinate about the hidden goal of the investment - to gain access to Odesa harbor for the ukrainian merchant fleet. The subordinate was a moldovan,supporter of the local romanian authorities and told everything to the mayor of Odesa.

In this way, an “investment crisis” arose regarding the non-charitable intentions of the hetmanist investments. The Hetmanate rejects all these claims as slander. Because of this, we can no longer carry out any economic activity through Odesa, so we will return to the original plans, ignoring the local authorities.
strings.FUK_begin_infiltration_desc: After the initial raids on strategic Romanian military targets in the regions, it is time to test them on the ground. Under cover of night, our soldiers will begin to cross the Southern Bug River, sowing chaos in Balta. Although this will provoke increased Romanian patrols, we will gain essential information about the location of the enemy for the ukrainian rebels. If everything goes according to plan, the rebels will receive the weapons they need and will be able to easily take full control of the Balta region in the first days of the uprising.
strings.FUK_send_our_generals_to_the_rebel_headq:
Due to the long-term control of our southern lands by the romanian military administration, prominent public ukrainian dissidents were detained and imprisoned. Fuel was added to the fire by a surge of violence in 1964 in connection with the crisis of the capture of local romanian politicians by ukrainian nationalists. Prominent leaders of the local OUN branch were detained and most of them executed.

As of now, the rebel forces are divided due to the lack of a single central command. Our duty is to discreetly deliver our officers and lieutenant-generals to Mohyliv and gather there a cell of the insurgent ukrainian movement.
strings.FUK_contact_with_partisan_cells_desc: Our preparations paid off, as we are now witnessing a protest surge in the region. The worst situation for us is now in Odesa, where the high-ranking german general Siegfried Hass has arrived to help the Romanian garrison. This criminal general took part in the battles for Kyiv in 1941 and the battles for Rostov in 1942. Without a doubt, he will not allow the victory of the rebels in the region, and since he will definitely not sit down at the negotiating table, the war in Transnistria will be fought until one of the sides is completely victorious.
strings.FUK_final_instruction_from_kyiv_desc:
The situation of the detail is quickly getting out of control, the rebels have overthrown the local romanian administration in Mohyliv region and we have the opportunity to directly start the process of transporting weapons there on a large scale. On the other hand, the romanians introduced their small army into the region in order to await the arrival of german military groups. This war will be brutal even with the victory of one side, and our final order from Kyiv to the rebels in Mohyliv will be as follows:

“Take up our weapons, ukrainian insurgents, fight, do not retreat! Fight - you will win! God help you!”
strings.FUK_light_a_fire_desc: Since the hostilities are in full swing, and soon the german-romanian volunteers will fully join them, we must distract the enemy's forces with our own provocative border attacks. It is also critical to arm the insurgents to continue their resistance. Dozens of trucks loaded with weapons will go from our Vinnytsia to the rebel forces. After a week or two of such transports, the rebels will be armed on par with german forces in the region!
strings.FUK_the_odesa_disaster_desc:
Something was missing, something was not calculated to the end, somewhere the battle was not won, other factors in the war strategy led to the total defeat of ukrainian rebels in Transnistria... This is a big slap in the face of our military capabilities and authority in the whole world stage.

Unfortunately, this is the reality, the rebels could not defeat the technically and professionally better prepared germans and romanians only on high morale. The chances for ukrainian Transnistria are lost forever, and the pro-german administration seems to be permanently entrenched in Odesa and the surrounding regions. The Ukrainian dream in Transnistria is lost, now forever...
strings.FUK_first_key_victory_desc: Our armed assistance and sabotage actions against the german-romanian forces helped the ukrainian rebels win a decisive victory in Transnistria! This great event will go down in our history books as the first “outright victory over the nazis in combat”. Undoubtedly, this victory will restore the suppressed morale of the ukrainian people regarding the possibility of confronting the nazi forces in Europe. Future generations of ukrainians will refer even more to this victory in confirmation of the ability to shake, if not completely destroy, the empire of evil in Europe!
strings.FUK_target_the_small_hungarian_empire_de:
From an external perspective, the Kingdom of Hungary, which is a member of the Unity Pact and a direct ally of the Reich, appears to be an untouchable state. However, this is a facade that rests on the remnants of past ambitions and the desire of hungarians to restore their borders to those that existed before the end of the First World War.

The Reich demonstrated that it is not going to fully implement hungarian ambitions, which means only one thing - the germans do not seek the creation of Greater Hungary. It is worth taking advantage of this fact in their relations and creating a situation where two members of the Unity Pact have hostile intentions towards each other. The nazis will of course support Hungary, but in the case of limited competition for Carpathian Ukraine, they will shift the responsibility to Budapest.
strings.FUK_choice_of_tactics_desc: It is important to decide on the correct choice of strategy for confrontation with Hungary. The reaction from Germania will directly depend on this choice. It is important for us to reduce this reaction to zero, or resort to another riskier strategy...
strings.FUK_direct_intervention_desc:
Our choice was to start military aggression towards Hungary. The chances of the insurgents victory without adequate arms supply from our side, due to logistical difficulties due to the topography of the Carpathian mountain, are quite unlikely. If we really want to return our Transcarpathia, we must show the courage of individuals to start military operations against the hungarian occupants.

They will no longer be able to escape our righteous punishment and deserve revenge for committing criminal acts against the will for the reunification of our people!
strings.FUK_using_the_same_methods_as_in_transni: In the Same Way as in Transnistria

Our choice fell on repeating the Transnistrian scenario. It is unlikely that the hungarians will independently agree to accept our investment proposals in the region after what happened in Transnistria. We will take a slightly different path and involve german businessmen cooperating with us in investing. Hungarians can refuse our businessmen, but they will not dare to refuse germans.
