strings.FUK_pull_the_wool_over_eyes_of_germania: Throw Dust in the Eyes of Germania
strings.FUK_pull_the_wool_over_eyes_of_germania_:
In order to prevent the direct intervention of the nazis, we must show the true realities of the situation. The region controlled by Hungary is not hungarian. In general, despite decades of assimilation, 44% of ukrainians who seek reunification with the Hetmanate live here. This protest movement wants liberation, and our goal is not to destroy the german ally, but to return the ukrainian ethnic territory.

As an example, we will compare Danzig to the Second World War, when the germans were in captivity and only direct military intervention returned Danzig to its homeland. The germans are sensitive to this topic, we will try to reach out and choose their own principles of building a stable Europe.
strings.FUK_necessary_measure_desc: In terms of logistics, the Transcarpathian War will be difficult and both sides will suffer significant losses. The best position in Hungary, because they have to protect the Carpathian mountain pass, which must be overcome. This will be the most difficult task for our military, already now we need to take care of the logical support of conducting hostilities in such unfavorable conditions.
strings.FUK_start_a_month_long_war_desc: Let's not waste precious time on empty chatter, the hungarians will never give us Transcarpathia. It's time to start the “Month War” - the term by which we hope to end the war. We do not know whether this optimistic forecast will come true, but the generals planning to break through the Carpathians in 2-3 weeks and completely crush the hungarians resistance. In that case we force them to sign a peace treaty that is not beneficial to them!
strings.FUK_ceasefire_desc: We have been utterly defeated, 6 months have passed since the start of the war of revenge, and we have not achieved any strategic goal... The hungarians have won over the Reich and now the entire Unity Pact is pressuring us to admit defeat. As a result of this peace, we are left with nothing, while the hungarians obtained from us the recognition of the Transcarpathian region as hungarian. The ukrainian people suffered another national catastrophe...
strings.FUK_return_of_transcarpathia_desc: Our century-old dream of regaining our own control over the distant ukrainian territory - Transcarpathia - has finally come true! With a military parade, we march through the entire region, including the regional center - Hust, as a sign of Hungary's humiliation. This is the moment when hungarian nationalism gave a serious crack for the first time since the end of the World War, and maybe not even the last, since romanians are increasingly turning their attention to Transylvania. Be that as it may, today is a big day for the entire Hetmanate!
strings.FUK_investment_proposal_desc: We will send a request to the local hungarian administration of Transcarpathia about our investment wishes, naturally with the active participation of german businessmen in the process. As much as the hungarians hate us, they still want to economically improve their remote region. In addition, the local hungarian elite, still with pacifist views in connection with the return of the Reich's dominance in Europe, does not notice the hidden motives for such a change in relations, which only to our advantage.
strings.FUK_pay_attention_to_dissidents_desc: It is necessary to start acting, the ukrainians of Transcarpathia will begin to take house after house, village after village, cities in order to finally expel the hungarians from the region. According to our data, the military contingent of the kingdom in the region is extremely small and ranges from several hundred to one thousand soldiers. The insurgents will easily force them to surrender in numbers, and the hungarians simply will not have time to suppress these attempts at an armed seizure of power, they will simply be unprepared for this scenario!
strings.FUK_smuggling_routes_desc: Looks like our initial plans have been a great success! The rebels were able to successfully take all key and strategic military bases, crossings, and communication routes. Most importantly, they have completely taken control of our border, which will allow us to unimpededly supply everything necessary to the ukrainian rebels for their resistance against armed aggression of Hungary.
strings.FUK_start_the_transcarpathian_conflict_d: We have little time left, the hungarians are accumulating forces along the uncontrolled Transcarpathia, and are determined to repeat the “Transcarpathian Blitz” just like 30 years ago. However, we have a trump card up our sleeve - special dissident hungarian agents whom we managed to bribe in peacetime. They can become a decisive factor in the war, because they know and have access to almost all warehouses with weapons in the Kingdom of Hungary, and this will allow us to steal these weapons right during the conflict!
strings.FUK_defensive_mountain_warfare_desc:
“Transcarpathian Blitz” is in full swing, the enemy is attacking regularly every week, and it seems that he is succeeding despite some setbacks. The positions of the local ukrainians are well-fortified, and with our volunteers they can hold out even longer, but there is a problem of choosing the right strategy to win this war.

Our commanders, having analyzed the defense structures and the inadequate quality of the rebels weapons, require us to choose the tactics of “defensive mountain warfare”. In this strategy, we will only force the rebels to hold the defense, avoiding the chance of an enemy breakthrough, but the morale of ukrainians will fall, and the enemy can take advantage of this in turn.
strings.FUK_counterattack_near_the_tisa_river_de:
“Transcarpathian Blitz” is in full swing, the enemy is attacking regularly every week, and it seems that he is succeeding despite some setbacks. The positions of the local ukrainians are well-fortified, and with our volunteers they can hold out even longer, but there is a problem of choosing the right strategy to win this war.

The command of our rebels demands to accept their strategy of victory over the armed aggression of Hungary. The so-called “counterattacks near the Tisa” is a series of counterattacks by ukrainian partisans together with our volunteers with the aim of driving the hungarian forces to the other side of the Tisa. The Tisa is a river that naturally separates our Transcarpathia from Hungary and provides ideal conditions for further defense.
strings.FUK_start_of_negotiations_desc: Hungarian Transcarpathian campaign has almost reached a dead end. There are fewer and fewer weapons, the passive behavior of the Reich, the growing dissatisfaction of the hungarian society with the continuing losses in the war, which does not interest them at all. Therefore, we must take steps to get the hungarian authorities to recognize the Carpathian-Ukrainian State as a separate state through german mediators.
strings.FUK_analysis_of_caucasian_turbulence_des: The agents we previously sent to the RK Kaukasien prepared an interesting report on the internal situation. Although no partisan movements or mentions were mentioned, considerable ethnic tension remains. Local representatives of national minorities, who are considered untermensch, periodically collectively refuse to go to weekly hard labor or run away in an unknown direction, or spend days in solitary confinement for disciplinary violations. One gets the impression that if a crisis suddenly starts in the Reichskommissariat, and external factors aimed at supporting national movements come into play, then this may again plunge the Kaukasus into the chaos of uprisings.
strings.FUK_destruction_of_the_rk_caucas_desc: From the point of view of our national interests and simply in a human way, our mission is to destroy the RK Kaukasien. The local enslaved peoples of georgians, azerbaijanis and others are losing their best sons and daughters every day. This situation of nazi oppression and genocide of other peoples of the Kaukasus has been going on for almost 30 years. It's scary to even imagine how many innocent souls have died...this can't last much longer. We should not put one above the other, as the nazis do. We must liberate all enslaved peoples of the Caucasus, this is our noble mission!
strings.FUK_lure_german_settlers_desc: If our secret aid to the peoples of the Kaukasus is exposed by the nazi special agents, it will not be possible to raise a single future uprising in the region! Instead, it is necessary to focus on one thing and carefully prepare a large-scale operation. Our mission is to prevent other countries from interfering in these events, so that the germans do not even dare to intervene directly! We will also carefully disguise our actions for our own benefit, focusing on bribing the germans and secretly supporting azerbaijani dissidents, since they are the most numerous group in the occupation of the RK Kaukasien.
strings.FUK_kharkiv_summit_desc: The Kharkiv Trade Summit is about to be held in the rebuilt city of Kharkiv, the pride of Eastern Ukraine. Heavily damaged in the Second World War, and in addition, it was the site of street battles against Shumskyi's supporters. In this short period of time, we managed to rebuild the city center to show the power of ukrainian engineering. The infrastructure of the city is ready to receive foreign delegations to sign agreements in the interests of the Hetmanate!
strings.FUK_take_advantage_of_their_weakness_des:
At the Kharkiv Trade Summit, representatives of the RK Kaukasus had the most uncertain position, complaining about their own seemingly endless problems in managing a million unruly population, which began to cause more and more problems within the Reichskommissariat after the end of the German Civil War.

This angered not even us the most, but the germans, who want more than anything to preserve their power in the Kaukasus. We will use this conflict to our advantage by presenting falsified data about the incompetent decisions of the Reichskommissar and bureaucrats to ignore urgent ethnic problems and turn a blind eye to strikes.
strings.FUK_germans_accuse_the_rk_caucasus_desc: We got our way, the nazis blindly got angry at the RK Kaukasus! They are threatening to increase the quota on local oil and will send their punitive forces to the region to help enforce the quotas. In this way, we eliminate two problems - due to their arrogance, the germans will not notice our secret intervention in the internal affairs of the Kaukasus. And the local people, in turn, will hate the occupying nazi government even more and sooner or later will rise up in rebellion to resist the murderous tyranny!
strings.FUK_only_chance_for_an_uprising: The Fuel Crisis Will Spark an Uprising in Kaukasus
strings.FUK_only_chance_for_an_uprising_desc:
The rebels received the last preparations and the last supplies, which means their full readiness to start and continue their national liberation uprisings. Their fate in this war now depends on us, it is our duty to send a volunteer contingent to help them. Fortunately, the flared-up oil crisis caused colossal economic losses in the Kaukasus, driving the rotten structure into debt, in combination with foreign intervention on our part, contributed to the collapse of the Reichskommissariat Kaukasien.

So let the Reichskommissariat Kaukasien burn in the hellish flames of its own slave-penalty system!
strings.FUK_secret_ties_with_mountain_peoples_de: We have an unestablished connection with the georgian national liberation movement. To contact them, we will send our agents of the Special Department, with german passports and perfect knowledge of the german language, so as not to attract unnecessary attention. Meetings with the georgians will take place after midnight at night in the countryside, away from the german patrols and punitive squads that hold firm control over the cities. We will ask the partisans what they need help with and provide them with everything they need to start a national uprising.
strings.FUK_start_the_kuban_blockade_desc: By sponsoring arms and financing insurgent movements in the Kuban with german currency, we will sow chaos in the main economic and supply artery of the Reichskommissariat. The local partisans, after a decade of calm, will sow chaos on the supply lines from the sea to the Kaukasus, accordingly making the main route for the delivery of weapons to the Reichskommissariat a risky occupation, thus isolating the main enemy for the Kaukasian insurgents.
strings.FUK_pay_for_the_uprising_with_german_mar: Financing the Uprising With German Marks

By massively financing the insurrectionary movements with german currency, it will provoke misunderstandings in the metropolis and chaos in the Reichskommissariat, which will eventually lead to the inevitable uprising. As long as the local administration focuses on investigating the origin of these funds, armed guerrillas will be able to take key administrative points in the region by surprise.
strings.FUK_boost_the_morale_of_the_rebels: Inspire the Rebels to Continue Their Resistance
strings.FUK_boost_the_morale_of_the_rebels_desc: It is necessary not to let that insurgent Caucasian spark of the insurgent peoples die out. We will contribute to the spread of Caucasian national military propaganda, which will aim to call on all sections of the population to fight against oppression, slavery, for the creation of their own national states. Those conscious versts, or simply representatives of the Caucasian nationalities most affected by the criminal actions of the authorities, will join the uprising, which may become the last opportunity to overthrow the power of the Reichskommissariat Kaukasien in the region!
strings.FUK_autarky_during_the_crisis_desc: We are greatly affected by the global economic oil crisis, as all our trading partners have drastically reduced oil sales, and in fact we are unable to continue purchasing the volumes of oil and fuel that existed before the crisis. The only way out of this situation is to start our own oil autarky in order to extract oil independently, from our own territories. In the future, we will be able to overcome this crisis over time!
strings.FUK_treaty_of_baku_desc: The peace treaty in Baku signals a new page in the history of some nationalities of the Caucasus, independent of the murderous and terrorist policy of the Reich. The complete end of the Nazi terror against representatives of the Caucasian nationalities is not yet over, but it is the beginning of the end. The Reichskommissariat Kaukasien suffered too much, and because of this catastrophic defeat it may be completely liquidated in the near future, perhaps even in this decade!
strings.FUK_katharinastadt_diktat_desc: According to the Katharinastadt Diktat, the Reichskommissariat Kaukasien maintains it's territorial integrity, and the insurgent movements of the peoples who rebelled are declared bandit movements, which will be eradicated over time. This is an extremely sad development for us and for the entire Caucasus, which has the last chance for liberation. This should serve as a lesson for us to plan more carefully further subversive operations against the Reich's sphere of influence.
strings.FUK_personal_dictatorship_of_the_skoropa:
Having suffered defeat after defeat in the international arena, Hetman Danylo Skoropadskyi granted himself unlimited administrative powers. From now on, legislative, executive and half judicial power is concentrated in his hands. The ukrainian people will protest, but as long as the army is on the hetman's side, nothing will threaten his power.

Another task in the coming years will be the rebuilding of Danylo own personality cult. With this process, sooner or later the ukrainian population will fall in love with its hetman-liberator again. This must happen so that Danylo's hetmanist case was not spent in vain all these years.
strings.FUK_realization_of_the_great_hetmanate_o:
The good news went around the entire Hetmanate, from the ukrainian Carpathians to the mountains of the Caucasus in the Kuban, a new superpower arose - the Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate, ready for a full-fledged competition in the Cold War. All national issues were resolved, proxy conflicts around our homeland were won, and our opponents were humiliated by their own arrogance. We were able to ensure a better tomorrow for all of our ukrainians.

However, we don't have to stop now, this is not the top. Europe continues to be under the Nazi boot, which we can no longer ignore. It's time to howl out of our home into the world and challenge the nazi bloodthirsty eagle!
strings.FUK_total_control_over_parliamentary_sys: Since we have finished the long process of recovery and reconstruction of the country from the ruins, new political challenges are coming. The civilian population, in general, after the example of punishment for communists, some nationalists and republicans who supported Dziuba, became apolitical, which cannot be said about coalition partners. Politicians who think only of their own interests, because the population is not interested in political life at the moment, will not oppose our control of the parliamentary system. Our legislative initiatives will only be hindered by former nazi administrators who got into our parliament simply because of connections.
strings.FUK_restricting_the_rights_of_supporters: Restrict the Rights of nazis Sympathizers

There is a threat to the advancement and implementation of our laws due to the large proportion of Nazi deputies who have already begun to obstruct the advancement of our politics of the day. Everything that does not fit their understanding of state formation, they sabotage. Of course, the Hetman can personally sign any bill once a month without the consent of the parliament, but when there are 5 or more such laws, and 3 of them fail the vote, this creates significant problems for the hetmanists. Since the opponents of the Hetman's policy continue to sabotage our policy, we will have to limit their right to vote, simply ignore them.
strings.FUK_isolate_nazi_sympathizers: Begin to Eliminate the Political Influence of the Nazis
strings.FUK_isolate_nazi_sympathizers_desc: We restored ukrainian statehood, we proclaimed the Ukrainian Hetmanate, the successor of the Ukrainian State of 1918, and we are unable to advance the pro-ukrainian agenda without its approval by german deputies in the parliament... No, we will not put up with this, as it has been done for the past 20 years, enough of numbing Ukraine, we will finally build a nationally oriented state for ourselves, without external influence!
strings.FUK_no_longer_tolerate_the_nsdap: Stop the Political Activities of the NSDAP
strings.FUK_no_longer_tolerate_the_nsdap_desc: First of all, we need to take care of the impossibility of electing new germans who had connections with the Reichskommissariat or the Reich to local self-government and the state parliament. For this purpose, we will assign this case to the Special Department, in order to counteract the attempts of the nazis to return to the management of the regions. They should clearly understand the fallacy of their views in our Hetmanate. The process of complete denazification in our homeland will take a decade or more, but it alone is worth it, and in the end, it will allow us to create a new country for ukrainians, not in words, but in deeds.
strings.FUK_set_an_example_for_collaborators_des: Carrying out our domestic pro-ukrainian policy, we cannot do without ukrainian collaborators. Yes, they made a mistake by cooperating with the Nazi administration, yes, they did not act in Ukrainian interests, but those were dark times. Now we are making history, starting everything with a clean slate, and those who want to correct their mistakes can tell in all the details about every day of the past cooperation with the nazis and the performance of various “dirty work”, apologizing for everything. And after that, they will actually work to improve the Ukrainian Hetmanate and punish the nazis who remain in opposition to us.
strings.FUK_cleaning_ohloblins_pawns_desc: In the years that have passed since we came to power in 1964, there remains a small proportion of “ohloblyntsi” collaborators who still refuse to cooperate, considering us “illegitimate”. The most intelligent of the collaborators, either out of their own good will or with a pragmatic calculation, long ago joined the ruling party of the Union of Hetmanites-Statesmen and were rewarded. If this is such a matter of principle - to continue to protest against our righteous cause - preservation of Ukraine, then, well, they will receive their prison terms for treason, the Special Department will take care of the availability of irrefutable evidence.
strings.FUK_strengthen_uhs_desc: For the sake of political stability and the continuation of the problem-free adoption of laws in the parliament, we must start spreading the popularity of the ruling party of the Union of Hetmanites-Statesmen in society. Everything is simple - you can join the party not thanks to the electoral or hereditary system, but by working in the interests of society. Each timely report of a crime, each investment in the development of ukrainian culture, service in the Armed Forces of the Hetmanate, or active legal protection of the poorest sections of the population, will be rewarded with a promotion to a public position and membership in the ruling party.
strings.FUK_write_our_own_history_desc:
Schools throughout our country faced the problem of the history of Ukraine being incorrectly interpreted in textbooks. Those textbooks, and in some places traitorous teachers, still define the status of the country before the nazi invasion of 1941 as “the times of the absence of state attitudes and the dominance of the asian-horde culture from the east on ukrainian territories.” The former USSR, which was governed from Moscow, was “socialist little russia(malorussia)”, and before the revolution of 1917 “the province of little russia(malorussia)”.

This is purposeful propaganda aimed at devaluing and ignoring ukrainian culture, population, and language, which in many respects echoes past russian narratives about our country. We must once and for all destroy this myth about “little russia(malorussia)” in our homeland and in the outside world.
strings.FUK_politicize_church_life_desc:
In the current struggle for the minds and hearts of society, church life plays an extraordinary role. Churches were not simply persecuted during the soviet and nazi regimes, because they are the structure that gives hope and views independent of the authorities in society. Now we have the Ukrainian Orthodox Church, which returned to our country from emigration, where it had been since 1918.

Our position on the church issue is clear - they should not be in opposition to the ruling party of the Union of Hetmanites-Statesmen, but even on the contrary - promote and praise His Highness Hetman Danylo, pray for the state creator every day and collect donations to the state treasury.
strings.FUK_ban_the_activities_of_the_nsdap: Final Ban on the NSDAP in Hetmanate
strings.FUK_ban_the_activities_of_the_nsdap_desc: Since we have purged our ranks of traitors and disobedient collaborators, the last opposition to us consists only of associates and remnants of Nazi scum. They showed us no mercy during the long twenty-year period of occupation, and every year they got rid of dear dissidents, effectively eliminating our intelligentsia, culture, language, the very ukrainian individuality, wanting to turn us into obedient slaves. These times are long in the past, and will not happen again, since Hetman Danylo started the dissolution of all nazi organizations, public associations, censorship of the german mass media, and by disbanding and expelling the “ukrainian” wing of the NSDAP party from the parliament.
strings.FUK_restore_breadbasket_for_our_own: Restore Breadbasket for Our Own Purposes
strings.FUK_restore_breadbasket_for_our_own_desc:
The “Breadbasket of the Reich”, this status depleted our fertile soil, and the nazi boot and agricultural machinery treated our agricultural sector with contempt, squeezing our resources to the maximum. And famine in ukrainian villages became regular every 3-4 years, that is why ordinary ukrainians so hated the occupying nazi government, which in terms of agriculture was no different from the soviet one, and in some places was even more cruel.

Everything turned upside down, as a ukrainian peasant could acquire german slaves who were suffering. However, unlike the germans, ukrainians do not look down on them, and even paid not only food, but also money for work successfully completed on Sunday. State subsidization of the new “Breadbasket of Europe” program will allow Ukrainian Hetmanate to become the largest exporter of agricultural products in Europe, and possibly in the whole world!
strings.FUK_prudent_moves_desc: In the process of restoring our statehood, the ukrainian population is apathetic towards the political situation in the Hetmanate. In connection with the complete reluctance to become at the helm of the country's management, we are forced to transfer part of the management powers to the hands of german settlers who have managed these lands for the past 10-15 years. Of course, we will not allow open sympathizers of the Reich and nazi sympathizers to rule the state in any way!
strings.FUK_allow_the_crimean_wing_of_the_nsdap: Allow Crimean Wing of the NSDAP
strings.FUK_allow_the_crimean_wing_of_the_nsdap_:
In order to reduce the growing tension in our Hetmanate, we should make an exception for the german settlers of the crimean peninsula. Their population dominates the region, so why should we provoke them into conflict and uprisings? In exchange for voluntary eviction from the Dnipro river area and Kherson region, we will grant them broad local self-government on the crimean peninsula.

They, most likely, will not mind reviving the long-desired Gotenland, under our tutelage, of course, and begin close cooperation in all spheres of life with ukrainians. For this, of course, we will have to leave the Gotenland NSDAP alone, but we will make sure that their policy was not conducted in the interests of the Greater Germanic Reich, but exclusively for the well-being of the region.
strings.FUK_german_investment_in_industry_desc: Seeing our benevolent policy towards german colonists settled in our territories, the government in Germania showed a desire to invest in our industry, creating thousands of new jobs. However, there are restrictions on the admission of only german population, as a result of the collapse of the Reichskommissariat. We will accept these good intentions by fulfilling all the conditions, these investments will help us in the long run to reduce poverty as much as possible.
strings.FUK_development_of_agriculture_in_crimea: Development of Agriculture on the Peninsula

Speaking about the problems on the Crimean peninsula, it is impossible not to notice the massive agrarian backwardness of mainland Ukraine. Such are the realities of the peninsula, which was 100% supplied with everything necessary directly from the Reich. Since this status quo cannot longer be continued, the need to at least bring the region's agricultural development closer to our southern regions, to promote the development of agriculture, and to finance private business and the trade sector falls on our shoulders. Now it may turn out to be too expensive for us, but in 1-2 years we will pay back all the costs from these humanitarian programs to save the peninsula from the crisis.
strings.FUK_start_construction_of_the_north_crim: Start Construction of the North Crimean Canal

To promote economic independence and permanently link Crimea with the Hetmanate economically, we need to build the North Crimean Canal, despite the high cost of the project. First and foremost, this is about overcoming the ongoing humanitarian crisis on the peninsula, everything else is a matter of national interests.
strings.FUK_relocate_nazi_supporters_to_crimea_d: With the legalization of the crimean branch of the NSDAP, the agrarian and scientific improvement of the region, and the active construction of the Northern Crimean Canal, it is time to resettle the entire population with national-socialist views to Crimea. To be more precise, the Gotenland Autonomous Reichsland in our Hetmanate. We will remain a unitary type of state administrative system, but to avoid constant instability in the south, our first autonomous region will be located there, with correspondingly wider powers and greater self-government than any of our other regions.
strings.FUK_scientific_development_of_the_region: Deep Scientific Funding for the Region

After major investments in the agricultural sector, we will continue to develop the strongest side of the peninsula - the scientific sector. Gotenland had a special administrative status as part of the Greater Germanic Reich, and attracted the brightest minds of Europe, because the necessary infrastructure existed for this. We will update research laboratories, testing grounds and rebuild the crimean airport for the easy arrival of german and other scientists to the peninsula. This direction of development is key, without which we will not catch up in the near future with the world's leading states in all fields, starting with electronics and ending with military tests of advanced weapons.
strings.FUK_form_an_autonomous_reichland_of_gotl: With the legal consolidation of the autonomous status of the Gotenland Autonomous Reichsland, a status that is similar to the past when the peninsula was controlled by the Greater Germanic Reich. However, this time both our ukrainian laws and local laws will be used together, and none of the laws will be dominant. We will give the right of free choice to local residents so that they themselves choose which laws to follow when resolving disputes. Nevertheless, more and more often the germans and assimilated ukrainians in Gotenland demand to be given wider powers for self-government, according to the federal system that existed in the German Empire. We have to take into account all the positive and negative sides when solving this difficult situation.
strings.FUK_continue_the_foreign_policy_course_d: With the solution of key internal issues, which could no longer be ignored, we return to external affairs. A new Caucasian conflict is looming on the horizon, local insurgents are stepping up individual raids against the Reichskommissariat authorities. It will be appropriate from the very beginning to investigate this direction and the prospects for the weakening of the Greater Germanic Reich, and at the same time help the nations that deserve it, get the long-desired independence. Sooner or later german total control in Eastern Europe will be eliminated, and it is in our interests to bring that moment closer.
strings.FUK_make_their_scientists_work_for_us: Make German Scientists Work For Us
strings.FUK_make_their_scientists_work_for_us_de: No matter how ukrainians hate the germans, our parliament, and Hetman in particular, cannot deny the scientific and research potential of the germans. Those who do not want to undergo repressions and feel the years of being in a prison cell will willingly agree to cooperate. We will immediately issue death sentences to those nazi inhumans who experimented on people. But we will allow those rays of modern technological innovations to manifest themselves, only now and finally under the banner of the Ukrainian Hetmanate. They will help to technologically catch up with other Cold War players in terms of military technology, in order to ensure our future technological superiority over all rivals.
strings.FUK_armed_forces_of_the_hetmanate_desc:
Since we are not currently threatened by any external military aggression, we have a unique opportunity to develop the Armed Forces of the Hetmanate, the army of the new Ukraine. During the Transnistrian collapse, we realized how important it is now to have a professionally equipped, trained, disciplined army to counter any foreign military threat to our side.

However, we need to choose one direction for our military reforms. The first option is the domestic one, which is offered by the majority of our military command. It envisages taking as a basis the structure of the “Free Cossacks”, which has already repeatedly proven its effectiveness in the civil war, by increasing the funding of this organization. And using the example of the structure of the elite “Free Cossacks” to rebuild all our ground forces, which will surpass all modern armies in Europe and allow us to repel all attempts to encroach on our territorial integrity.

The second option is to more globally reform our army, following the example of the German Wehrmacht. Although it is more expensive than the previous option, we will focus, in addition to the land component of our army, on the aviation and naval components, improving everything evenly. Modern war is a complex one, which combines not only war on land, this was proved by the doctrines of the USA, which successfully win proxy conflicts all over the planet. We will take the structure of the german Wehrmacht as a basis, adapting it to ukrainian conditions of limited spending on the military and focusing on key reforms to improve the Armed Forces of the Hetmanate.
strings.FUK_example_of_free_cossacks_desc: The organization of the “Free Cossacks” exceeded all our expectations, becoming a truly elite force, the family of our entire army. If not for weapons, then for sure for fighting spirit and cossack discipline, they serve as a living example of what a modern ukrainian cossack army should look like. The elite forces of the Wehrmacht and the Waffen-SS would never again be considered the most professional force in Europe. We will repeat the professionalism and combat effectiveness that the ukrainian cossacks had in the 17th and 18th centuries, only now in a much larger and modern armed plan, clearly prioritizing the development of land forces!
strings.FUK_copy_the_structure_of_the_wehrmacht: Copy the Structure of the Wehrmacht
strings.FUK_copy_the_structure_of_the_wehrmacht_: It was the german New Order that was established in Europe, due to the effectiveness and modern preparedness of the Wehrmacht to conduct any necessary operations. Without a doubt, we should take their example to improve our Armed Forces of the Hetmanate if we want to surpass them. Without risking possible failures in the structuring of our forces, we will already take the ready-made structure of the german Wehrmacht, adapting it to the ukrainian mentality and war traditions. So, repeating the german successes in military reforms that took place in the 1930s, we have the goal of surpassing their successes in our own efforts to build the newest european army. By focusing on, in addition to the land component, we will equally improve our aviation and naval capabilities to conduct modern warfare!
strings.FUK_mass_production_of_domestic_weapons_: No war in Europe since the First World War has been won without weapons superior to the enemy. It became a fateful moment in our history, because in 1919 and 1920, due to the poor equipment and lack of ammunition of our army, we lost the war for independence, losing for half a century the opportunity to restore our own long-lost statehood. That is why, if we do not continue to learn from our past critical mistakes, we risk losing new wars that will determine our future destiny.
strings.FUK_diversify_our_industry_desc: If the war in the air is lost, the enemy will start bombing our factories and industrial facilities, which will endanger the stable production of all weapons for the army. An army poorly equipped with weapons will not be able to win any war, and realizing this, we will carry out the dispersal of our military-industrial complex throughout the country. Instead of their further placement in cities, we will begin to relocate them to rural areas far from state borders.
strings.FUK_build_military_bases_desc: Our military commanders, senior officers, and officers complain about the lack of barracks and military bases to house their continuously expanding army. In some cases, especially in the east of our country, military personnel are forced to live in the middle of the sky, in the forest in dugouts, as the ukrainian partisans did during the nazi rule. This cannot continue, the new, modernized and numerous european army must be provided with everything necessary, most importantly - housing. This will significantly reduce the incidence of illness, increase professionalism and proper conditions for living and staying in the army for all our soldiers.
strings.FUK_maintain_discipline_in_the_army_desc: In the desire to form a modern ukrainian cossack army in Europe, one cannot do without proper discipline. Even the most trained and most modern armed soldier will lose in a battle with a socialist-bolshevik soldier, who in his desire for revenge and properly disciplined will not leave a chance to our soldier. Each of our soldiers will have their own daily schedule of their duties, and will also get a chance to raise and increase their own salary for showing discipline and their own initiative in helping recruits to fulfill the set minimum of behavior in the army. In this way, we will ensure not only high discipline in military units, but also promote strong cossack brotherhood in our military.
strings.FUK_motorize_the_army_desc: Our cossack army will not consist only of infantry units. We will pay due attention to the process of motorization and mechanization in the army. Without spending too much public money on the production of tanks, which lose to well-armed light infantry with anti-tank weapons, we will direct our expenses to increase the production of military vehicles. Each infantry brigade will have at least 25 trucks and 5 armored personnel carriers. It is this equipment that is the cheapest to manufacture and will best contribute to the efforts of our military to perform various types of combat tasks, ensuring their rapid movement from one part of the front to another.
strings.FUK_a_new_powerful_force_in_europe_desc:
As of today, all of Europe has met a new, numerous and motivated ukrainian cossack army, which will now play a special role in the security situation on the continent. It is especially worth paying attention to the spirit of the improved ukrainian army, since no other force in Europe will be able to reach and surpass the cossack fighting spirit.

With the state funding of the secret project “Cossack Spirit”, we will instill in our soldiers a sense of pride in service in our armed forces, a boundless love for the motherland, and an understanding of the importance of daily training to improve the skills already acquired. After that, they will be ready to fight to the death, being disarmed, with the enemy, to lay down their heads for the fate of free Ukraine. In this way, guided by the ukrainian interpretation of the warlike of Yamato-Damashi spirit, they will truly become the most formidable force that Europe has ever known.
strings.FUK_studying_blitzkrieg_tactics_desc:
The military doctrine of “Blitzkrieg” allowed the germans to easily defeat all their opponents, who were not ready for maneuverable tank warfare. We will draw lessons from this for ourselves as well, when preparing the tank army for the fastest possible victory, using the ukrainian version of “Blitzkrieg” against our enemies. Based on this doctrine, part of our army will be tank-based, and in combination with light infantry attacks, we will win most battles with minimal loss of personnel.

Unlike the germans, in future battles we will combine tank breakthroughs with infantry attacks on the flanks, in order to reduce equipment losses, immediately upon successful breakthrough of enemy positions.
strings.FUK_reform_the_regimental_system_desc: No matter what military experts prove the advantages of material support as opposed to the size of the army, we know like no one else how important the size is. With the ever-increasing growth of our military aviation and fleet, we are noticing insufficient personnel in these areas. The country lacks skilled pilots and sailors knowledgeable in the maritime field, this must be corrected. From now on, at least 5% of our entire population will serve in the army for 2 to 5 years, depending on the type of army. For example, we will recruit reservists for 5 years for service in the army, 3 years for service in aviation and navy, and 2 years for service in logistics units.
strings.FUK_formation_of_tank_fists_desc: In order to improve the offensive capabilities of our armed forces, we need to supply each brigade with at least 10 tanks, and form whole tank brigades from 50 units of tanks. From ourselves, we will produce improved domestic T-62 units, in various modifications, special attention will be focused on the T-62K, which will have better communication with infantry units through a built-in radio, and will also have longer fuel for a longer duration of fighting. So, having started the tactics of concentrated “tank fists” in the army, no fortified position will help the enemy to repel our lightning strikes in defense!
strings.FUK_concentrate_industry_desc: The explanation for such a large amount of german equipment, which generally allowed them to win the Second World War, is their policy of “industrial concentration”. Their military-industrial complexes were compactly concentrated on the Rhine and in the center of the country. Why did they place them like that and not separately? Because they rebuilt the Luftwaffe in such numbers to keep their skies clear of enemies, we are doing the same. The concentration of the military-industrial complex compactly in cities will allow us to start mass production of everything we need, with minimal costs for maintaining such complexes throughout the country!
strings.FUK_spartan_discipline_desc:
We have seen with what efficiency, despite the open scars from the civil war, the german Wehrmacht in a fairly short period of time regained control over all of Central and Eastern Europe. This is the freshest proof of the superiority of the spartan army discipline over our beloved enemy, and we must surpass all other european armies in this respect. However, our army will not be raised in blind ideological loyalty unlike the germans, but entirely on patriotism and personal duty to preserve ukrainian statehood.

Our soldiers must understand that if they do not complete the specified term of service in the Armed Forces of the Hetmanate, they will put the existence of our Hetmanate at risk for the following years.
strings.FUK_the_best_replacement_of_the_wehrmach:
As of this morning, Europe has met a new comprehensive Armed Forces of the Hetmanate, which can boast not only professional land forces, but also developed aviation and naval forces. Indeed, not only our ground forces march proudly, not only infantry and tanks in unison, advanced models of fighters, interceptors, stormtroopers and even bombers fly above them. European journalists were even more shocked, and journalists from the Unity Pact were completely frightened - the ukrainian Black Sea Fleet proudly performed sea maneuvers and in some places fired loud cannon shots, not far from the port of Sevastopol.

All this shocked not only journalists, these cadres took away the gift of speech from the leading politicians of the Unity Pact countries, due to which they refused to comment on such a rapid reconstruction of all branches of the military by the Ukrainian Hetmanate. Without a doubt, such a short period of reforming the army will also set the pace for the further secret projects about improving “Armed Forces of the Hetmanate”, which will aim to increase the efficiency of the performance of all new tasks assigned to the various types of troops.
strings.FUK_complete_army_reforms_desc: With the successful completion of the initial process of reforms in the land forces of our army, which will include further development and improvement, we are already close to the return of that formidable Cossack force that successfully took Moscow in the 17th century and protected all of Europe from Ottoman expansion. We are still far from such feats, but very, very soon we will catch up with the army of the Greater Germanic Reich in fighting capacity and proper equipment, which will create a significant obstacle for the undisputed control of the Wehrmacht over all of Europe!
strings.FUK_form_the_ukrainian_air_forces_desc:
Returning the air fleet of the Hetmanate is our historic task to protect the ukrainian sky and all our population on earth. It is necessary to clearly understand the depth of the issue of air war, which is no less important than the war on land. For almost a whole decade after the end of the West Russian War, the german Luftwaffe bombed and terrorized the civilian population, bombed the entire local industry, and made trade and any commercial activity a risky business.

During the time of the Ukrainian State in the summer of 1918, despite the lack of specially prepared aircraft factories and the huge shortage of qualified aircraft designers, more than 200 military aircraft, including bombers, were already registered then. Therefore, our task is to exceed this number by at least 10 times, to ensure the modernization of existing aircraft models and, as a final result, to surpass the Luftwaffe in terms of the quality of our aircraft. This is a vitally important matter, aimed at the safety of our cities, economy, and society from the possibility of aerial bombardment during a possible war.
strings.FUK_restore_the_black_sea_fleet_desc:
Our naval pride, stolen by other states, the Black Sea Fleet, is now in the shadow of its former self. Since the end of the Second World War, it was seized from bolshevik control by nazi invaders, just like our country too. Although there were repeated attempts by the new owners to improve this fleet with the same more modern models that the Greater Germanic Reich had, in the end, due to the denial of the right to pass the Bosphorus Strait to the german military fleet by the turkish authorities, the fleet was not improved in any way.

After the temporary loss of control over all the Reichskommissariats in the East, the German Black Sea Fleet was handed over to the Gotenland authorities in the Crimea. However, our lightning capture of the peninsula was a surprise for the german admirals of the Black Sea Fleet, who did not manage to evacuate in time. As a result of this, we successfully returned our Black Sea Fleet, and we arrested its german admirals. Now they are subject to criminal liability for the kidnapping of the ukrainian fleet, and will certainly receive a fair punishment!
strings.FUK_purchase_old_german_luftwaffe_aircra: Because we started training a new generation of qualified aircraft designers, as well as the creation of state aircraft construction complexes in Kryvyi Rih, Vinnytsia, Kramatorsk and Nizhyn. These will be the main centers of aircraft design complexes in the Hetmanate, which will create a powerful base for expanding the number of our military aviation forces. We now have only the creation of advanced schemes for aircraft, fighters, interceptors, attack aircraft, bombers and strategic bombers for the technological improvement of the Hetmanate's aircraft quality!
strings.FUK_ukrainian_german_air_exercises_desc: In an effort to catch up and overtake the rival German Luftwaffe, we must first learn everything about them. Joint ukrainian-german exercises, which we will disguise as “our desire to test advanced German aircraft in combat conditions,” will best agree on this. They will not refuse this idea, since their “invincible” Luftwaffe will successfully shoot down our old soviet planes, which we do not regret. At the same time, we will investigate the speed, maneuverability, combat ability to hit the target and fuel reserves of the Luftwaffe aircraft, and we will build our own aviation, better than theirs, based on these obtained data. The times will come when our aviation will be stronger in the european skies.
strings.FUK_production_of_domestic_planes_desc: In order to fulfill the task set by our aircraft designer to produce new models of various types of domestic aircraft, it is necessary to allocate significant funds from the state budget. The number of new aircraft produced directly depends on the state financing of these programs, and we ourselves will decide what amount of the budget to spend on the development of our air forces. This decision will undoubtedly provide us with a clear sky from enemies, or on the contrary, these efforts may not be enough for us.
strings.FUK_ensure_a_new_generation_of_pilots: Ensure a New Generation of Pilots
strings.FUK_ensure_a_new_generation_of_pilots_de: Everything possible in our power to improve our air force and modernize existing aircraft models has been done. Funds are allocated, trained aviators test and learn to fly planes, and aircraft designers work 10 hours a day to provide our aces with the entire arsenal of new aviation. According to our calculations, in the next 5 years we will be able to raise a conscious generation of ukrainian aviation aces who will be able not only to defend our ukrainian skies, but also to successfully protect the skies of the entire Eastern Europe from enemy forces and even more!
strings.FUK_repair_damaged_part_of_the_fleet: Repair Damaged Part of the Fleet
strings.FUK_repair_damaged_part_of_the_fleet_des: About half of the Black Sea Fleet cannot leave the shipyards without incident, and the other part does not have a combat charge, actually a torpedo for naval warfare. Again, the responsibility for repairing all the ships fell on our shoulders. According to approximate estimates, it can take from 5 months to 2 years, depending on the quality of the repair work. Fortunately, we have experienced naval personnel from the peninsula, in particular german engineers, who chose to rehabilitate us from the repression of the nazi occupiers by rebuilding the Black Sea Fleet. With their conscientious and hard work, they must prove that they are ready to change their worldview and live obediently in ukrainian society. We hope this will speed up the restoration of our long-lost power in the Black Sea.
strings.FUK_copy_the_japanese_model_of_medium_sh: Copy the Japanese Model of Ships

Many empires in history had a large fleet, but the best efficiency and effectiveness in sea battles was demonstrated by the japanese fleet, which defeated its most formidable and numerous opponent - the american fleet - in the Pacific Ocean. Their maneuverability, and especially their firepower, defeated all competitors, and even now the Imperial Japanese Navy dominates the Pacific Ocean. We are fascinated by their success, and will send our own diplomatic mission to Tokyo, in order to invite the old schemes of models of japanese ships of the late 1950s, which still show themselves quite well in sea battles.
strings.FUK_allocate_a_budget_for_building_new_s: Allocate a Budget for Building New Ships

In order to increase our advantage at sea, we must start serial production of the latest types of ships, which, in combination with our ukrainian sailors, will without exaggeration become the most formidable force in the Black Sea. Again, the volume of production of domestic ships will require more financing of this process from the state budget. We already spend 28% of the annual state budget on the improvement of the ground forces, and from this moment on, the costs of increasing the size of the domestic fleet are added. Perhaps it would be better to save costs in the area that we are not so interested in, unlike land and aviation development?
strings.FUK_the_new_navy_ruler_of_the_black_sea: New Navy Ruler of the Black Sea
strings.FUK_the_new_navy_ruler_of_the_black_sea_: Now we can undoubtedly maintain our undisputed maritime control of the Black Sea. After all, even the turks, if they send their entire fleet to the Black Sea, will quantitatively lag behind our restored Black Sea Fleet. But we have room to grow, as our fleet is now not comparable to the italian, iberian, not to mention the german Kriegsmarine. Undoubtedly, the shipbuilding complexes in the Crimea, Mykolaiv and other ports will help us in the coming years to approach the italian fleet in terms of strength and numbers, and after that to surpass the Kriegsmarine itself.
strings.FUK_new_color_tv_desc:
Although the situation surrounding our country remains unstable, and the repercussions of the oil crisis are officially being hushed up, a bubble of calm is forming. Over the past year, oil prices have risen by 20 - 25%. To distract our population, we are launching a massive campaign to “televise the country” - the production of new domestic color televisions. As the number of televisions in homes increases, the population will almost certainly be captivated - everyone will immerse themselves in watching our censored television programs.

To facilitate the broadcast of TV programs, which will primarily promote the hetmanist movement narratives and other cultural content highlighting the virtues of the Ukrainian people, we will undertake the construction of a network of cathode-ray tubes and cables stretching across the entire country. The price of one such television will be about 50 USD - which is roughly 40-45% of a Ukrainian's monthly salary. The list of state-funded companies that will manufacture these televisions is extensive, namely: “Slavutych” (Kyiv), “Foton” (Simferopol), “Vesna” (Dnipro), and “Berezka” (Kharkiv).

We plan to provide the entire country with high-quality, affordable color TVs by the end of the 1970s. And by the next decade, we will be among the top 10 countries in the world with the highest penetration of color TVs among their populations!
strings.FUK_first_program_about_crisis_desc:
“What on earth did they show?!” - the officials exclaimed in outrage upon hearing the shocking, previously censored information that had been broadcast on recent television news programs. News programs, which were supposed to broadcast government-filtered reports on successful agricultural initiatives or new car models, instead covered news about the crisis. The public knew why gasoline and fuel prices were rising in the Hetmanate and about the crisis-ridden wars in the Middle East, but here the truth was being revealed from behind the scenes.

The news program “Vitchyznyany Vistnyk”, without permission from high-ranking officials and bypassing our state censorship, told the public the whole truth about the crisis. This defiance lasted two days, after which their broadcasts were suspended and the group of journalists was fired, but it still outraged our population. Immediately, everyone across the country began hoarding fuel, which was in short supply, exacerbating the already tense and unstable situation. Because of these events, fuel prices are rising uncontrollably, and within a matter of days, we will have exhausted all our civilian oil reserves...
strings.FUK_use_coal_for_the_needs_of_the_popula: In a desperate attempt to offset the massive fuel consumption in our country, large-scale coal sales are being introduced. Often, it is sold for next to nothing - less than 1 USD for a 50-kilogram bag of coal. This coal is mined in the Donbas, so to ensure uninterrupted coal production, we will extend the work shift for all miners by 2 hours. This is a temporary measure to stabilize the domestic situation until the oil crisis is finally resolved, and if there are not enough current workers, working hours will be increased for all our miners!
strings.FUK_use_the_fleet_to_import_oil_desc: Maintaining and expanding maritime trade involving the import of foreign oil is our cure-all for this crisis! That's right, we will increase funding for tankers and cover all their costs to transport the thousands of barrels of oil we so desperately need each week. And even if this means cutting the budget for train engineers and redirecting our spending from the civil transport sector to the trade sector - we will do it. Our tankers will sign oil supply contracts with oil-producing nations unaffected by war - Venezuela, Mexico, or Saudi Arabia - to stabilize our domestic market.
strings.FUK_analyze_our_initiatives_desc:
We have taken every possible step to overcome the crisis quickly, even going so far as to cut taxes for the public. At the same time, the statistics have not improved significantly, no matter how hard all our workers, merchants, and businesses have tried...

The crisis continues, and although more than a year has passed since it began, it continues to inflict damage on our country. No, this is not the time to ignore it and focus on conflicts or military buildup; by doing so, we only exacerbate the domestic crisis. Our people must remain our top priority, and the Hetman's task is to demonstrate leadership, set aside his ambitions for a time, and turn his attention to the ordinary Ukrainian. Our citizens have spent their last funds; civilian vehicles are now a rare sight on the capital's roads - this is a matter of the people's well-being and daily life. From now on, by focusing on the root causes of the ongoing crisis, we will address it specifically in the sectors where it continues to exist and harm the country.
strings.FUK_quick_actions_to_solve_the_oil_crisi: Quick Actions to Overcome the Oil Crisis

In fact, our initial crisis response measures were not in vain; as a result, the burden on civilians has been somewhat alleviated. This is a sign that we should not stop, but rather maintain our rapid pace to overcome the oil crisis as quickly as possible.

Starting with the temporary use of coal as a precautionary measure and tankers for oil transportation, we will continue to explore unconventional solutions. But not such extreme measures; we will now switch to synthetic oil, which, just like coal, will alleviate our crisis for a while. Moving forward, we will need to continue signing international agreements with developed countries that are ready to export large volumes of oil. In this way, we will not only return to our pre-crisis situation in record time, but we will also be secured with oil for years to come!
strings.FUK_the_slower_you_go_the_further_you_wi: The Slower You Go, the Further You'll Get

Why chase after quick-fix, short-term alternatives to address the oil crisis? This does not lead to meaningful results; it only exacerbates and postpones the consequences of the crisis. Instead of blindly chasing “immediate results”, we will invest in practical and necessary solutions that will keep our country afloat.

We will now ban the use of coal in industry and will not rely solely on expensive tankers to sustain our oil industry. To start, the government, together with parliament, will pass a series of laws prohibiting our monopolistic companies from freely exploiting all oil fields (both discovered and undiscovered) in the country. The privatization of the oil industry by private companies is fatal to our military machine. By placing the entire oil production industry under state control, we will prevent further oil shortages.
strings.FUK_introduce_a_ban_on_exports_desc: Our anti-crisis measures will have no tangible effect without the introduction of protectionism. Our domestic oil is worth its weight in gold right now; we shouldn't squander it by exporting it abroad. By banning all exports of our oil, we won't face a shortage, and our government will become more popular among the ukrainians, who will appreciate our new rhetoric. This may harm our profits and the lion's share of oil sales in the short term, but it will allow us to stabilize gasoline prices in Ukraine's domestic market.
strings.FUK_promote_private_business_desc:
After examining several causes of the crisis, we noticed a curious pattern in the way our oil fields were managed by civil servants and state-owned enterprises. Before we came to power, they were still managed by German private firms. During the short tenure of the previous administration, they were handed over to the local administration, and shortly thereafter seized by the Hetmanate's agencies.

Since then, oil production has not increased compared to the period under the former German administration. Is this not a sign of our administration's inefficiency in managing such fields? In light of the onset of the global crisis and the rising cost of “black gold” on the world market, a number of private - and even local - enterprises have approached us with a request to transfer these fields into their possession. Legally, the state continues to own them, but in practice, private companies manage and operate them, and the revenues are divided equally between the parties. Thus, by carrying out such “limited privatization”, we will significantly increase the efficiency of oil production at any location within the Hetmanate where it is found.
strings.FUK_shock_therapy_to_the_oil_industry: Shock Therapy for the Oil Industry
strings.FUK_shock_therapy_to_the_oil_industry_de:
The current state of affairs and the ongoing oil crisis are the result of a combination of problems. The main one is the backwardness of our oil industry and its failure to adapt to modern conditions and challenges. We were entirely dependent on oil trade, particularly on supplies from Romania and the Caucasus, while neglecting our own untapped potential.

In recent years, the situation has begun to change, especially after we came to power, but for the most part, the same economic agreements remained in place as during the time of the Reichskommissariat. However, this crisis has shown us the reality of the situation: in this world, we can rely only on ourselves.

Therefore, the government has developed a “Shock Therapy” program - a process of artificially accelerating the search for and extraction of oil exclusively within our territories. At the same time, international experts and geologists will participate on a voluntary basis, which will help speed up the exploration process, of course, with the signing of a non-disclosure agreement.
strings.FUK_western_fuel_plantations_desc:
Our western Ukrainian lands, particularly Galicia, are very rich in oil and salt deposits. During its time as part of Austro-Hungarian Empire in the 19th century, this region earned a reputation as the area with the largest number of oil fields. And for good reason, since the city of Drohobych is at the heart of this reputation.

Our control over these territories is key to the energy security of our Hetmanate, and the Germans know this better than anyone else. They will never voluntarily hand over Drohobych to us, so we need to carefully weigh all our means and methods of influence, applying all the economic levers at our disposal. We will use their own “peaceful weapon” - under the guise of investment, we will encourage Ukrainian oil companies to establish control over the oil fields in western Ukraine.
strings.FUK_put_trade_under_state_control_desc:
In fact, our complete reliance on foreign natural resources, particularly oil, has backfired on us. Now it is no longer a matter of necessity, but a matter of self-sufficiency in securing “black gold”. The borders with our neighbors - specifically those who have been exporting oil to us - will be closed.

All cargo crossing our checkpoints will be thoroughly inspected, and documents will be cross-checked multiple times. This is not an import ban, but rather a restriction aimed at promoting domestic production and sales of petroleum products, energy independence, and internal stability during the crisis.
strings.FUK_start_sustainable_oil_autarky_desc:
Even during the Caucasus crisis, when the local peoples were fighting for their own state against German occupation, we attempted to establish our own oil self-sufficiency. However, due to the lack of expertise in this matter among the appointed officials, we were unable to do so.

Thus, Minister Bilopolskyi presented and emphasized his intentions to revive this failed project. In his opinion, it has potential and will benefit our country by accelerating the resolution of the crisis. The funds have already been calculated, and the launch of self-sufficiency is in the final stages of implementation.
strings.FUK_find_ways_around_the_German_sanction:
By imposing significant economic sanctions on us - effectively an embargo - the German eagle hopes to defeat us through gradual economic exhaustion. But these German bureaucrats have failed to take into account a key fact that is unpleasant for them: our status as an independent country.

We will launch our own diplomatic initiatives around the world, starting with European countries - Italy and Turkey - and ending in Japan. These countries are our top priorities in terms of diplomacy, trade, and gaining recognition of our country's independence in Europe. Paradoxically, most of the world still considers us dependent on the Germans, with a government appointed from Germania - which is German propaganda and narratives aimed against us.

In the face of such discrediting, we must prove to the world that this is a lie and tell the truth about a promising, independent, and investment-friendly Greater Ukrainian Hetmanate.
strings.FUK_decentralize_the_oil_sector: Decentralization of the Oil Production Sector
strings.FUK_decentralize_the_oil_sector_desc:
As we reform the administration of newly discovered oil fields, we must also take into account our negative past experiences. Direct state ownership of certain sectors of the economy, including the oil industry, is not always the right approach.

The crisis that has dragged on until now serves as clear evidence of the inefficiency of such ownership. We must review all our initiatives in this area and carry out the necessary decentralization. We must finally reject the misconception that “Kyiv will manage Western Ukraine's oil” and distribute ownership regionally. Our western oil will be managed by the administrations of western Ukrainians, and the southern oil - primarily by central oil production companies.
strings.FUK_plan_of_the_minister_of_fuel_desc:
It is the responsibility of the state apparatus and the relevant authorities to resolve such a serious crisis. This task cannot be delegated to anyone else, and the hetman himself is involved in this important matter. At a meeting of ministers, including the Hetman, further steps to resolve the crisis were discussed and agreed upon.

First, we must complete the transition to oil self-sufficiency, as we are surrounded on all sides by rival neighbors. Second, to achieve self-sufficiency, we will find as many oil fields as possible within our territories. Third, we will find new partners who will supply us with the cheapest oil until we establish our own production at a sufficient level.
strings.FUK_introduce_a_quota_for_oil_production:
Our population continues to suffer primarily due to a shortage of gasoline for vehicles. Gas stations are empty because the government's priorities for oil supplies are focused on military and industrial needs. Due to the shortage and the resulting decline in transportation, the government will begin implementing quotas to ensure oil supplies to the civilian sector.

The availability of gasoline at gas stations is a key element in maintaining order in the country. Therefore, we will temporarily implement priority coupons for gasoline for the next 3-6 months. Emergency services - such as medical, police, and fire departments - will receive it first. Ordinary citizens, on the other hand, will receive it second, on an equal footing with foreigners. This will not solve the fuel shortage, but it will establish a rhythm by which society will function during the crisis.
strings.FUK_oil_development_in_the_center_desc:
As we move into the second phase of overcoming the crisis, we are focused on the prospect of developing oil fields in Central Ukraine. We are particularly interested in Kryvbas - the mineral-rich regions of Dniprovs'ka Oblast'.

Our geological teams have identified numerous oil fields, including in Pavlohrad and in Tavria. Very soon, our workers and state-owned oil production companies will head there to extract these resources. Thanks to this important discovery, as well as the protectionist policies we have implemented, we will soon practically match Romania's level of oil production.

And once the crisis has passed and all our strategic goals have been successfully achieved, we will be ready to open up trade in energy resources!
strings.FUK_caucasian_oil_sources_desc:
Amid a turbulent, devastating oil crisis that sparked a resurgence of local national liberation movements in the Caucasus, the oppressed peoples threw off their shackles. With our military and financial assistance, they demonstrated that no repressive machine lasts forever, and that every crime committed will be met with inevitable punishment.

For us, their success means the opening of new markets. Their mineral resources, including vast and large oil deposits, are a key resource for any superpower. By concluding such agreements behind the Germans' backs, we will secretly obtain the resources we so desperately need in a short time. In this way, we will smoothly overcome the current crisis and maintain sustainable economic development.
strings.FUK_solved_the_crisis_before_global_plan: Crisises are Over, It's Time for Our Global Plans

The long period of internal conflict, only exacerbated by the global oil crisis, seems to have come to an end. These years have been turbulent, but by uniting around their hetman, Ukrainians have found their path, one that everyone is now ready to follow willingly. This path leads to an inevitable confrontation with the Nazi evil that has engulfed most of Europe. Recent years have united Ukrainians to such an extent that no one opposes the Hetman movement anymore; on the contrary, everyone is doing everything in their power to prepare for this special day.

A special day - rather, our nation's long-awaited scenario for overcoming our main rival in Europe. The coming war is inevitable; the key question is who will be ready to start it. Eastern Europe is only the beginning of what will determine the entire future of Europe, as the West Russian War has proven. And where the Russians suffered a crushing defeat, our brave Ukrainian people - who have defeated the most formidable armies in Europe time and again in the past - will drive the final nail into the rotten Nazi New Order.

For if not us, then no one else will overcome the German war machine, the nuclear superpower that, up to this point, has still not subjugated our chivalrous Ukraine.
strings.FUK_unbearable_oil_crisis_desc:
Our unbearable oil crisis, which continues to anger the people, will only grow deeper and deeper. Combined with anti-government protests - particularly those against the hetman's dictatorial powers - this creates a volatile mix. Under these circumstances, we must address one of these problems; the most obvious choice is to resolve the oil crisis.

The Hetman's administration understands what Ukrainians, driven to dire living conditions, are capable of, so the focus now is on the well-being of the people, not on the military-industrial complex. Prices for essential goods, including food, will be controlled by the state, and private businesses will face a series of requirements.

In the event of a violation of the maximum permissible prices for goods, regardless of region, such businesses and enterprises will be nationalized. Using this lever of influence, we will stop unfair competition and maintain stability in the domestic social situation.
strings.FUK_all_work_as_one_desc:
In times of crisis like these, our people must stand united and rely on their own government. Danylo understands this historically proven fact, so he will begin to cultivate his own “cult of personality” by traveling across the country.

The first and main goal of these trips is to encourage the population to work toward overcoming the oil crisis. In this way, by cooperating with the government rather than competing against it, all parties will be satisfied. In our situation, the stick will destroy us, while the carrot will resolve all the tension that has arisen in society.
strings.FUK_prosperity_of_the_hetmanate_desc:
“Dear Ukrainians, who has taken the helm of restoring our statehood, who has prevented the Germans from occupying our beloved homeland, who has prevented direct or behind-the-scenes foreign control?” - such messages from the hetman echo through radios, televisions, and loudspeakers across the country. The goal is precisely to preserve the patriotic spirit of Ukrainians, regardless of any internal crisis.

Every one of our citizens must understand that there is no alternative - the Ukrainian Hetmanate is the only form of government and type of state that can save Ukraine during the nazi New Order. This is no longer merely a logical truth, but the only real fact, and to deny it is ridiculous. Only the Hetmanites saved Ukraine back then, which means they can save it now and tomorrow from any crises!
strings.FUK_and_oil_independence_desc:
Finally, thanks to all our previous efforts to stabilize the situation and gradually overcome the energy shortage, we will disconnect from the European power grid! What once seemed unrealistic, a mere fantasy, has become a reality; from now on, our Hetmanate is capable of providing electricity to all its citizens on its own.

This event is already being called the “Ukrainian Energy Miracle” because no other country - a former member of the German Unity Pact - has been able to achieve this. This process has been ongoing since the German invasion, aimed at restoring the Reichskommissariat, in an effort to prevent the inevitable - Ukraine's breakaway from its sphere of influence, including the energy sector. Now, proud of his people, Hetman Danylo is ready to show the world once again what an independent Ukraine is capable of under national leadership!
strings.FUK_explore_all_oil_fields_desc:
Funding for the state-owned integrated company “Ukrnafta”, which specializes in oil production, continues to yield immense benefits. Thanks to a technological breakthrough in the early 1970s, exploration and production of oil began at deep (3,000–5,000 m) and ultra-deep (over 5,000 m) levels of the earth's crust. And the largest energy resource deposits in Ukraine are found in Left Bank of Ukraine, in the Dnipro, Yuzivka, and Poltava regions - over 150 explored oil and gas fields.

This year, we are ramping up geological exploration at a record pace, which is enabling us to discover a number of new large deposits across Ukraine. The peak oil production level was reached in 1972 - 14.5 million tons (this figure is half that of Mexico). The eastern regions contain about 85% of the natural gas reserves and about 60% of the recoverable oil reserves of the Ukrainian Hetmanate. By further developing this promising sector and improving oil production from known fields, we will no longer rely exclusively on foreign oil in the foreseeable future.
strings.FUK_move_workers_to_the_excavation_of_oi: Relocate Workers to Oil Mine Excavations

The geopolitical situation on the world stage has repeatedly demonstrated the fallacy of relying solely on global trade in resources. To avoid suffering such serious consequences again, we must begin to rely on ourselves and on our hardworking citizens. Accordingly, the government has decided to redeploy workers from factories in various industries specifically to the development of oil fields.

All these redeployments will be carried out exclusively on a voluntary basis, and wages for such jobs will be higher than at their previous places of employment. Also, unlike the old Donbas mines, which have not been updated in terms of modernizing work processes, we will be opening new ones. Specifically, we are talking about promising oil fields in the Dnipro-Yuzivka Basin, Kryvbas, and the Volyn coal basins.
strings.FUK_unexpected_German_trade_support_desc:
Following several of our defeats in proxy conflicts, the hetman was forced to assume dictatorial powers in order to ensure the continued existence of the hetman movement. Essentially, this involves preserving an authoritarian, right-wing fascist regime that is of interest to German diplomats and economists. Officially, we did not abolish private property for Germans in our country, nor did we nationalize their enterprises.

Whether with the aim of “easing” the rather tense bilateral relations or for some other purpose, the German Führer proposes to relax the established embargo by allowing the import of German goods into the territory of the Hetmanate. The main condition for this easing of sanctions is that trade is conducted exclusively with ethnic Germans on our territory, and not with Ukrainians.

This is clearly a discriminatory agreement that will undermine our internal stability; however, on the other hand, the German population in our state will determine exactly how to distribute the goods received. It will likely be more profitable for them to sell such scarce goods to Ukrainians rather than distribute them among members of the German nationality.
strings.FUK_start_anti_crisis_propaganda_desc:
Such a large-scale oil crisis in our country can be said by the dissatisfaction of the population. Despite some success in removing obstacles and resolving logistical issues, our gas stations still lack between 50 and 80 percent of the necessary fuel, gasoline, diesel, and in some cases even natural gas.

Given this situation, the Ministry of Information proposes the traditional solution to public discontent: state propaganda. The government has already approved an official state “prevention” of discontent, including practical measures. This will be implemented across all media, from newspapers to public speeches in public spaces.

We will urge the public to use only public transportation - buses and trams, and the metro in major cities - instead of private vehicles. Partially acknowledging the truth, we will cite the experience of the past, noting that our Cossack ancestors did not use cars at all. Of course, everyone understands that these measures are temporary, until the situation is fully stabilized and the crisis is overcome, and they will treat the current situation with understanding.
strings.FUK_enter_temporary_vouchers_for_purchas:
Our valiant emergency services continue to work day and night, regardless of any crisis. However, this crisis often prevents them from reaching the scene of an emergency in time, as their emergency vehicles lack fuel. Minister Bilopolskyi, however, very aptly proposed introducing temporary gasoline vouchers for this vital group of people.

Medical personnel, police, rescue, and fire services - all of them rely on civilian vehicles, which require a steady supply of fuel every day. This is precisely where our focus will lie in the redistribution of fuel reserves. These services must carry out their duties as usual, as we are talking about the well-being, lives, and safety of our citizens, which is our top priority!
strings.FUK_bribe_the_new_owners_of_oil_in_the_c: Relations with the Owners of Caucasus Oil

At the height of the oil crisis, the Reichskommissariat Kaukasien faced a series of national liberation uprisings, which we supported.
