However, the situation is now even more complicated than before, since the rebels, although victorious, now find themselves effectively isolated. It is our duty to support them by all means, bring them onto the international stage, and integrate them into global trade.

They are our new and promising partners for building fair and mutually beneficial bilateral relations. There is also another hidden aspect to such “trade relations” - those that are publicly announced and declared. We are talking about a comprehensive strategic partnership, ranging from military to economic cooperation. We will strengthen the mountain people to the point where their existence will no longer be threatened by a new German invasion.

By supplying the latest weapons, our professional military instructors, and sharing our technologies, special fraternal bonds will be established between our nations.
strings.FUK_the_oil_crisis_is_over: The Oil Crisis is Finally Over
strings.FUK_the_oil_crisis_is_over_desc:
It seems the worst is definitely behind us, and we have even surpassed pre-crisis oil production levels! After a brief period of stagnation, the economy will soon return to sustainable growth, supported by an updated framework for oil consumption.

Things are looking up for civilians as well; all gas stations have received the minimum required supply of oil and fuel, and there is enough gasoline for everyone's cars. But recent events have worn out our Hetman, who has been working beyond his daily routine, carefully reviewing every report on the crisis while listening to classical and popular Ukrainian songs on the radio.

Everyone in the government feels that this unbearable crisis, which has finally ended, is only the beginning of an unpredictable chain of subsequent problems in the country. Undoubtedly, the public's attention will shift from this overcome oil crisis to something else, and we must be prepared for any turn of events.
strings.FUK_but_hetmans_headache_only_worsened_d:
Our illustrious Hetman Danylo Skoropadskyi has not been appearing in his office since the beginning of the month. His personal aide reported to Bilopolskyi that he has been feeling unwell for quite some time and is unable to make important state decisions on his own. All because of persistent headaches that began recently due to work-related exhaustion.

This is a serious challenge for both the ruling government and the entire Ukrainian Hetmanate. The role of the Hetman cannot be overstated, as he has assumed all key powers - effectively dictatorial - and he also oversees foreign relations. However, since assuming these powers, he has not made a single official visit to any other country, and diplomats continue to work only in those countries with which diplomatic ties have been established. Therefore, until our leader has fully recovered, the country will be governed by a council of ministers headed by the energetic and pragmatic Andriy Bilopolskyi.

Let us all pray for the speedy recovery of His Excellency the Hetman...

strings.FUK_fight_against_proletarian_threat_cat:
The remnants of Shumskyi's movement, which included socialist agitators, militant national-bolsheviks, and sometimes disillusioned anarchists, began to establish a network of underground cells in the Donbas. These terrorists must be dealt with by force as soon as possible, as we risk an uprising in the case of new war.

Our security services - State Guard must begin operations in the east to isolate, identify, and destroy this new threat. From information obtained from Shumskyi POW`s, we know the locations of terrorist bases in the Yuzivka region and part of the Kharkiv region. However, after the initial raids in these territories, we became aware of other centers located in the Luhansk and even Rostov regions. Since the security of the important domestic labor front is at stake, we must do everything in our power to overcome all this socialist filth. The Ukrainian Hetmanate is no home for bolshevik terrorist scum!
--------------

strings.FUK_funnel_resources_to_infiltration_des: The excision of the national-bolsheviks menace will not be an easy one. From studying marxist literature to Oleksandr Shumskyi's philosophy, our State Guard agents must not reveal their true intentions to terrorists. We can divert extra resources from other security departments into the process of infiltration in order to improve our operation capabilities.
strings.FUK_infiltrate_proletarian_cells_desc: Although we do not currently know the exact number of all socialist terrorist resistance cells, we have identified informants within this movement, which means that we have obtained the key information we need. Sending SG agents disguised as impressionable citizens to join their ranks will give us valuable intelligence and allow us to draw them into our clutches, without the socialists suspecting a thing.
strings.FUK_inspect_factories_in_luhansk_desc:
Luhansk workers, geographically distant from the center of our country, violate disciplinary requirements every day, do not show up regularly at work, forge medical certificates, and are quite dissatisfied with our recent decision to increase working hours, which could cause significant problems for production.

However, since we have already established surveillance and personal connections with some of these suspected proletarians, such behavior will very soon be nipped in the bud once and for all.
strings.FUK_strengthen_security_supervision_of_w:
The example of the situation in the Luhansk factories, and in the Donbas region in general, showed us the real situation among workers who broke their chains of constant oppression by the Nazis. Socialist elements are currently taking advantage of this, but once these dissidents have been rounded up, the situation in factory life will change for the better.

We will increase the lunch break, during which we will engage in the proper education of workers in the values of the Hetmanate, and for exceeding the daily norm, we will begin to release workers from work earlier! If the dissident elements in industry initially go on strike, State Guard agents will catch them and place them in solitary confinement for several weeks.
strings.FUK_begin_mass_arrests_of_workers_sympat:
We have now gathered comprehensive information about the proletarian terrorists of Shumskyi and are ready to deliver targeted devastating blows that will deprive them of their limbs, and then we will clean up the remnants of this underground movement.

Surprisingly, the enemy was right under our noses-in the Kharkiv region. Their organizational headquarters is located in the city of Balakliya, which does not even suspect that our military in the vicinity are already awaiting Skoropadskyi final order to clean up this terrorist lair, and he will definitely give this order for the prosperity and security of the Hetmanate.
strings.FUK_the_final_raid_against_national_bols: Launch the Final Raid Against National Bolsheviks

Our fight against the socialist proletarian threat is almost over. All that remains is to make the final touches to the attack on the terrorist bases on the map of the Donbas region, and the job will be done!

The leaders of the movement have been captured, leaving behind their first deputies, officers, and disoriented rank and file. On their own, they do not pose a threat, but they are like a lizard that can regrow its tail and paws and cause us problems again in the future. We will, of course, offer these fighters the opportunity to surrender, because we ourselves have much to learn from the underground struggle against the occupiers, but those who refuse to lay down their arms will be neutralized as a direct threat to national security.

strings.FUK_north_crimean_canal_category_desc:
Our recently acquired territories of Taurida and the Crimean peninsula are facing a new crisis - a real humanitarian catastrophe! Reports indicate that the peninsula has run out of fresh water, and our supplies are arriving weeks late at best, or worse, disappearing due to sabotage by nazi extremists who have been waging a guerrilla war for three years since we liberated Crimea....

Until the temporary collapse of the Reich control over Eastern Europe, Crimea was completely supplied by its “motherland” and only when it began to destroy itself did the Crimean authorities realize their true precarious position. The remnants of the Black Sea Kriegsmarine were able to supply food to the dependent Crimea for some time, until our liberation. We, in turn, having no merchant fleet, began to transport fresh water, food, luxury items, and medicines by truck and sometimes by cart. These deliveries were extremely difficult to transport due to the lack of intact roads and the need to cross natural obstacles. Unfortunately, the Kherson bridge across the Dnipro river was blown up during the civil war and has not yet been restored.

To solve this problem, we are forced to involve the Nazi wing of the former Gotenland administration, otherwise we will never completely defeat the local partisans. Thanks to the work of the Gotenland NSDAP with the local population, we will focus on economic recovery and improvement of the region. This will definitely be of interest to the germans and other members of the Black Sea region, as we will make Crimea an economic zone free from Kyiv. On the peninsula, apart from the autonomous local administration, there will be no national taxes, limited military service, and no Ukrainian economic and trade laws to promote the prosperity of the region.

Thus, the population of Crimea, mostly germans, will become favorable towards us and recognize us as the legitimate authority in the region. After some time, they will live even better than during the 20 years of German occupation!

strings.FUK_project_CossackSpirit_category_desc:
After so many decades of foreign occupation of our lands, we didn't have the opportunity to build truly substantial and well-armed forces. Fortunately, we now have this, and all that remains is to give our Armed Forces of the Hetmanate the status of the most professional and best-trained troops in continental Europe. Our new project - COSSACK SPIRIT, should help us with this.

 For the last quarter of a century, the german Wehrmacht was considered the “most formidable force in Europe” due capture all of continental Europe. Now these troops are only a shadow of their former power, as proven by the First West Russian War, and their career ended with the break of Civil War in the Reich. We must surpass them in the military training and professionalism of our boys. The Free Cossack troops have distinguished themselves in our structure, gaining invaluable experience in proxy-wars against our neighbors, including battles against the germans.

We will not only catch up with the military level of the german Wehrmacht, we will surpass them!

For too long, German boots trampled on nations and peoples in Europe, for too long no one could resist them, for a long time the Wehrmacht was considered invincible... But after Reich near-total defeat in the first West Russian War, the well-crafted german myth of the “invincible Wehrmacht” was debunked.

Now we have the resources, the ability, and the goal to improve the professionalism, training, and armament of our military. Instead of focusing exclusively on the ground forces, we will repeat the Reich's development program before the start of World War II, while simultaneously improving our air and naval forces. We will take everything wonderful from the german Wehrmacht and use it to form a new MODERN ARMY OF THE UKRAINIAN HETMANATE.

strings.FUK_proxy_events.5.d:
Our volunteers are returning to their homeland in Mykolaiv, confirming the rebels complete victory in the war. This event was celebrated throughout the country, from Volhynia to Rostov, because for the first time since 1941, Ukrainians were in control of the port city of Odesa and other liberated cities in Transnistria.

This victory is followed by a long process of rebuilding the economically devastated region, planning its inclusion in our unified Ukrainian Hetmanate, and resolving ethnic issues that have accumulated significantly over the last decade in the region.Added to this are the fates of tens of thousands of prisoners of war, who are now of direct interest to delegations from the Greater Germanic Reich and the Kingdom of Romania.

Although the Ukrainian population of Transnistria is optimistic and helping to rebuild the devastated region, the process promises to be long and difficult, as there are still large pockets of romanian-moldovan population that continue to sabotage Ukrainian authority in the region, even though they do not pose a significant threat to the new government. They need to be dealt with now, so we will send all the necessary resources to the Dniester and Bug Administration.
strings.FUK_proxy_events.5.a: This is how the Winner Judges the Losers
strings.FUK_proxy_events.6.d:
Due to our limited military capabilities to compete with the Germans in helicopter and tank technologies, we were forced to recognize the sovereignty of the German military garrison in Odesa.

The most we could gain from this unfortunate situation would be to send troops into the part of the Vinnytsia region occupied by the Romanians since the end of World War II-Mohyliv.The base where the uprising actually began is now completely destroyed by the war, and it seems that the Germans are not opposed to the annexation of this bombed-out part of Transnistria, as they have not yet expressed any claims or condemnations regarding the change in the border.

However, the main goal of this proxy war has not been achieved-to regain control of the port city of Odessa, which, judging by all appearances, will not return to us.
